info.description_zh: 愛迪生國際是一家再生能源公司，透過其子公司生產和分配電力，並投資能源服務和技術。該公司成立於 1886 年 7 月 4 日，總部位於加利福尼亞州羅斯米德。

info.description: Tandem Diabetes Care, Inc. engages in the design, development, and commercialization of products for people with insulin-dependent diabetes. Its products include Tandem Mobi System and t:slim X2 Insulin Pump. The company was founded by Paul M. DiPerna on January 27, 2006 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Tandem Diabetes Care, Inc. 致力於為胰島素依賴型糖尿病患者設計、開發和商業化產品。其產品包括 Tandem Mobi System 和 t:slim X2 胰島素幫浦。該公司由 Paul M. DiPerna 於 2006 年 1 月 27 日創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州聖地亞哥。

info.description: Cintas Corp. engages in the provision of corporate identity uniforms through rental and sales programs. It operates through the following segments: Uniform Rental and Facility Services, First Aid and Safety Services, and All Other. The Uniform Rental and Facility Services segment consists of the rental and servicing of uniforms and other garments including flame resistant clothing, mats, mops and shop towels, and other ancillary items. The First Aid and Safety Services segment includes first aid and safety products and services. The All Other segment contains fire protection services and its direct sale business. The company was founded by Richard T. Farmer in 1968 and is headquartered in Cincinnati, OH.
info.description_zh: Cintas Corp. 透過租賃和銷售計劃提供企業形象制服。它透過以下部門運作：制服租賃和設施服務部門、急救和安全服務部門以及所有其他部門。制服租賃和設施服務部門包括制服和其他服裝的租賃和服務，包括阻燃服裝、墊子、拖把和抹布以及其他輔助物品。急救和安全服務部門包括急救和安全產品和服務。所有其他部門包括消防服務及其直銷業務。該公司由 Richard T. Farmer 於 1968 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州辛辛那提。

info.description: eGain Corp. engages in the development, licensing, implementation, and support of customer service infrastructure software solutions. Its solutions include financial services, insurance, retail, travel and hospitality, ecommerce, helpdesks, and marketing. The company was founded by Ashutosh Roy and Gunjan K. Sinha on September 10, 1997 and is headquartered in Sunnyvale, CA.
info.description_zh: eGain Corp. 從事客戶服務基礎設施軟體解決方案的開發、授權、實施和支援。其解決方案包括金融服務、保險、零售、旅遊和酒店、電子商務、服務台和行銷。該公司由 Ashutosh Roy 和 Gunjan K. Sinha 於 1997 年 9 月 10 日創立，總部位於加州桑尼維爾。

info.description: Eaton Corp. Plc is a power management company, which provides energy-efficient solutions for electrical, hydraulic, and mechanical power. It operates through the following segments: Electrical Americas and Electrical Global; Aerospace, Vehicle, and eMobility. The Electrical Americas and Electrical Global segments engage in sales contracts for electrical components, industrial components, power distribution and assemblies, residential products, single and three phase power quality, wiring devices, circuit protection, utility power distribution, power reliability equipment, and service. The Aerospace segment supplies aerospace fuel, hydraulics, and pneumatic systems for commercial and military use. The Vehicle segment deals with the design, manufacture, marketing, and supply of drivetrain and powertrain systems and critical components that reduce emissions and improve fuel economy, stability, performance and safety of cars, light trucks and commercial vehicles. The eMobility segment designs, manufactures, markets, and supplies electrical and electronic components and systems that improve the power management and performance of both on-road and off-road vehicles. The company was founded in 1911 and is headquartered in Dublin, Ireland.
info.description_zh: 伊頓公司是一家電力管理公司，為電力、液壓和機械動力提供節能解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：Electrical Americas 和 Electrical Global；航空航太、車輛和電動車。 Electrical Americas 和 Electrical Global 部門從事電氣元件、工業元件、配電和組件、住宅產品、單相和三相電能品質、接線設備、電路保護、公用配電、電力可靠性設備和服務的銷售合約。航空航太部門提供商業和軍事用途的航空燃料、液壓和氣動系統。車輛部門從事傳動系統和動力系統以及關鍵部件的設計、製造、行銷和供應，以減少排放並提高轎車、輕型卡車和商用車的燃油經濟性、穩定性、性能和安全性。電動交通部門設計、製造、行銷和供應電氣和電子元件及系統，以改善公路和越野車輛的電源管理和性能。該公司成立於1911年，總部位於愛爾蘭都柏林。

info.description: Global-e Online Ltd. engages in the provision of cross-border e-commerce solutions. It offers Global-e Pro and Global-e enterprise. The firm enables merchants to increase the conversion of international traffic into sales by providing online shoppers across global destinations with a seamless, localized shopping experience. Global-e Online was founded by Shahar Tamari, Amir Schlachet, and Nir Debbi on February 21, 2013 and is headquartered in Petach Tikva, Israel.
info.description_zh: Global-e Online Ltd.從事提供跨境電子商務解決方案。它提供 Global-e Pro 和 Global-e enterprise。該公司為全球目的地的線上購物者提供無縫、在地化的購物體驗，幫助商家提高國際流量轉換為銷售額的能力。 Global-e Online 由 Shahar Tamari、Amir Schlachet 和 Nir ​​Debbi 於 2013 年 2 月 21 日創立，總部位於以色列佩塔提克瓦。

info.description: National Security Emerging Markets Index ETF seeks to track the results, before fees and expenses, of the Alerian National Security Emerging Markets Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in component securities of the index. The index consists of stocks listed on globally recognized stock exchanges that excludes companies benefiting end-users that, in the view of the sponsor of the fund, National Security Index, LLC (the "Sponsor") pose a threat to the national security interests of the United States.
info.description_zh: 國家安全新興市場指數 ETF 旨在追蹤 Alerian 國家安全新興市場指數（未計費用和開支）的結果。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於該指數的組成證券。該指數由在全球公認的證券交易所上市的股票組成，不包括使最終用戶受益的公司，該基金的發起人 National Security Index, LLC（「發起人」）認為這些公司對美國的國家安全利益構成威脅。

info.description: Martin Marietta Materials, Inc. is a natural resource-based building materials company, which engages in the provision of aggregates including crushed stone, sand, and gravel through its network of quarries and distribution yards. It operates through the East Group and West Group segments. The East Group segment offers aggregates and asphalt products. The West Group segment focuses on aggregates, cement, downstream products, and paving services. The company was founded on November 12, 1993 and is headquartered in Raleigh, NC.
info.description_zh: Martin Marietta Materials, Inc. 是一家以自然資源為基礎的建築材料公司，透過其採石場和配送場網路提供碎石、沙子和礫石等骨材。它透過東集團和西集團部門運作。 East Group 部門提供骨材和瀝青產品。西部集團部門專注於骨材、水泥、下游產品和鋪路服務。該公司成立於1993年11月12日，總部位於北卡羅來納州羅利。

info.description: Payoneer Global, Inc. is a financial technology company, which engages in providing a financial platform for small and medium-sized businesses to transact and do business. It operates through the Israel, United States, and All Other Countries geographical segments. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Payoneer Global, Inc.是一家金融科技公司，致力於為中小型企業提供交易和開展業務的金融平台。它透過以色列、美國和所有其他國家的地理部門開展業務。該公司成立於2005年，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Vulcan Materials Co. engages in the production of construction aggregates. It operates through the following segments: Aggregates, Asphalt, and Concrete. The Aggregates segment produces and sells aggregates and related products and services. The Asphalt segment relates to the production and selling of asphalt mix in Arizona, California, New Mexico, Tennessee, and Texas. The Concrete segment refers to the production and selling of ready-mixed concrete in California, Maryland, and Virginia in addition to the U.S. Virgin Islands and Washington D.C. The company was founded in 1909 and is headquartered in Birmingham, AL.
info.description_zh: Vulcan Materials Co. 從事建築骨材生產。它透過以下部分運作：骨料、瀝青和混凝土。骨材部門生產和銷售骨材及相關產品和服務。瀝青部門涉及亞利桑那州、加利福尼亞州、新墨西哥州、田納西州和德克薩斯州的瀝青混合料的生產和銷售。混凝土部門是指在加利福尼亞州、馬裡蘭州和維吉尼亞州以及美屬維京群島和華盛頓特區生產和銷售預拌混凝土。該公司成立於 1909 年，總部位於阿拉巴馬州伯明罕。

info.description: Silvaco Group, Inc. provides technology computer aided design software, electronic data automation software and semiconductor intellectual property. The TCAD, EDA and SIP solutions enable semiconductor and photonics companies to increase productivity, accelerate their product's time to market and reduce their development and manufacturing costs. Its services include SPICE Modeling Services, TCAD Modeling Services, Library Design Services and Library Characterization Services. The company was founded on November 18, 2009 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA.
info.description_zh: Silvaco Group, Inc. 提供技術電腦輔助設計軟體、電子資料自動化軟體和半導體智慧財產權。 TCAD、EDA 和 SIP 解決方案使半導體和光子學公司能夠提高生產力、加快產品上市時間並降低開發和製造成本。其服務包括 SPICE 建模服務、TCAD 建模服務、庫設計服務和庫表徵服務。該公司成立於2009年11月18日，總部位於加州聖克拉拉。

info.description: Lyft, Inc. engages in the provision and management of an online social rideshare community platform. It offers access to a network of shared bikes and scooters for shorter rides and first mile and last-mile legs of multimodal trips, information about nearby public transit routes, and Lyft Rentals to offer riders a view of transportation options when planning any trip. The company was founded by Marcus Cohn, John Zimmer, Rajat Suri, Matt van Horn, and Logan D. Green on March 5, 2007 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Lyft, Inc. 從事線上社交乘車共享社群平台的提供和管理。它提供共享自行車和踏板車網路的存取權限，以實現短途騎行以及多式聯運的第一英里和最後一英里行程、附近公共交通路線的資訊以及Lyft Rentals，以便乘客在計劃任何旅行時了解交通選擇。該公司由 Marcus Cohn、John Zimmer、Rajat Suri、Matt van Horn 和 Logan D. Green 於 2007 年 3 月 5 日創立，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: Reading International, Inc. is an entertainment and real estate company, which engages in the development, ownership, and operation of multiplex cinemas and retail and commercial real estate in the United States, Australia, and New Zealand. It operates through the Cinema Exhibition and Real Estate segments. The Cinema Exhibition segment includes Reading Cinemas, Angelika Film Center, Consolidated Theatres, City Cinemas, 44 Union Square, and Liberty Theatres brands. The Real Estate segment consists of real estate development and the rental or licensing of retail, commercial and live theater assets. The company was founded by James J. Cotter Sr. in 1999 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Reading International, Inc.是一家娛樂和房地產公司，在美國、澳洲和紐西蘭從事多廳影院以及零售和商業房地產的開發、擁有和營運。它透過電影展覽和房地產部門運作。電影展覽部分包括 Reading Cinemas、Angelika Film Center、Consolidated Theatres、City Cinemas、44 Union Square 和 Liberty Theaters 品牌。房地產部門包括房地產開發以及零售、商業和現場劇院資產的租賃或許可。該公司由 James J. Cotter Sr. 於 1999 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Diamondback Energy, Inc. is an independent oil and natural gas company, which engages in the acquisition, development, exploration, and exploitation of unconventional, onshore oil, and natural gas reserves. It operates through the Upstream and Midstream Services segments. The Upstream segment focuses on the Permian Basin operations in West Texas. The Midstream Services segment is involved in the Midland and Delaware Basins. The company was founded in December 2007 and is headquartered in Midland, TX.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣勘探與生產
info.description_zh: Diamondback Energy, Inc.是一家獨立的石油和天然氣公司，從事非常規、陸上石油和天然氣儲量的收購、開發、勘探和開採。它透過上游和中游服務部門運作。上游部門專注於德克薩斯州西部的二疊紀盆地業務。中游服務部門涉及米德蘭和特拉華盆地。該公司成立於2007年12月，總部位於德克薩斯州米德蘭。

info.description: Harvard Bioscience, Inc. develops, manufactures, and sells technologies, products and services that enable fundamental research, discovery, and pre-clinical testing for drug development. It operates under the geographical segments: United States, Germany, China, United Kingdom, and Rest of the World. It sells its products through catalog, Website, distributors, and direct sales force. The company was founded by Dr. William T. Porter in 1901 and is headquartered in Holliston, MA.
info.description_zh: 哈佛生物科學公司開發、製造和銷售技術、產品和服務，為藥物開發的基礎研究、發現和臨床前測試提供支援。它在以下地理區域運作：美國、德國、中國、英國和世界其他地區。它透過目錄、網站、分銷商和直銷隊伍銷售其產品。該公司由 William T. Porter 博士於 1901 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州霍利斯頓。

info.description: Myriad Genetics, Inc. engages in the discovery, development, and marketing of transformative molecular diagnostic tests. The company was founded by Walter A. Gilbert, Mark H. Skolnick, and Peter D. Meldrum in May 1991 and is headquartered in Salt Lake City, UT.
info.description_zh: Myriad Genetics, Inc. 從事變革性分子診斷測試的發現、開發和行銷。該公司由 Walter A. Gilbert、Mark H. Skolnick 和 Peter D. Meldrum 於 1991 年 5 月創立，總部位於猶他州鹽湖城。

info.description: Aldeyra Therapeutics, Inc. is a biotechnology company, which engages in research and development activities related to general business planning, including raising capital. It focuses on the discovery of therapies designed to treat immune-mediated diseases. The company was founded by Thomas A. Jordan and John E. Dowling on August 13, 2004 and is headquartered in Lexington, MA.
info.description_zh: Aldeyra Therapeutics, Inc.是一家生技公司，從事與一般業務規劃相關的研發活動，包括募款。它專注於發現旨在治療免疫介導疾病的療法。該公司由 Thomas A. Jordan 和 John E. Dowling 於 2004 年 8 月 13 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州列剋星敦。

info.description: Cardio Diagnostics Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of medical diagnostic testing services. It also develops and commercializes a series of products for major types of cardiovascular disease and associated co-morbidities including coronary heart disease (CHD), stroke, heart failure, and diabetes. The company was founded in 2007, and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: Cardio Diagnostics Holdings, Inc. 從事提供醫療診斷測試服務。它還開發和商業化一系列針對主要類型心血管疾病和相關併發症的產品，包括冠狀動脈心臟病（CHD）、中風、心臟衰竭和糖尿病。該公司成立於 2007 年，總部位於伊利諾州芝加哥。

info.description: TE Connectivity Plc is a company that engages in the provision of connectivity and sensor solutions for the purpose of distribution of power, signal, and data. It operates under the following segments: Transportation Solutions, Industrial Solutions, and Communications Solutions. The Transportation Solutions segment include terminals and connector systems and components, sensors, relays, antennas, and application tooling. The Industrial Solutions segment include terminals and connector systems and components, interventional medical components, relays, heat shrink tubing, and wire and cable. The Communications Solutions segment include terminals and connector systems and components, antennas, and heat shrink tubing. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Galway, Ireland.
info.description_zh: TE Con​​nectivity Plc 是一家致力於提供用於電力、訊號和資料分配的連接和感測器解決方案的公司。它的業務分為以下幾個部門：運輸解決方案、工業解決方案和通訊解決方案。運輸解決方案部門包括終端和連接器系統及組件、感測器、繼電器、天線和應用工具。工業解決方案部門包括端子和連接器系統及組件、介入醫療組件、繼電器、熱縮管以及電線和電纜。通訊解決方案部門包括終端和連接器系統及組件、天線和熱縮管。該公司成立於2007年，總部位於愛爾蘭戈爾韋。

info.description: AvePoint, Inc. operates as a digital collaboration innovator, which provides data management services. It develops, markets, and sells its suite of software solutions and services in North America, Europe, Australia, and Asia. The company was founded on July 24, 2001 and is headquartered in Jersey City, NJ.
info.description_zh: AvePoint, Inc. 是一家提供資料管理服務的數位協作創新者。該公司在北美、歐洲、澳洲和亞洲開發、行銷和銷售其軟體解決方案和服務套件。該公司成立於2001年7月24日，總部位於新澤西州澤西市。

info.description: Morningstar, Inc. engages in the provision of investment research. It offers Morningstar data, direct, investment management, advisor workstation, workplace solutions, pitchbook data, enterprise components, research, credit ratings and indexes. It operates through the following segments: Morningstar Data and Analytics, PitchBook, Morningstar Wealth, Morningstar Credit, Morningstar Retirement, and Corporate and All Other. The Morningstar Data and Analytics segment is involved in providing investors data, research and insights, and investment analysis to empower investment decision-making. The PitchBook segment focuses on providing investors with access to a broad collection of data and research covering the private capital markets, including venture capital, private equity, private credit and bank loans, and merger and acquisition activities. The Morningstar Wealth segment refers to model portfolios and wealth platform, practice and portfolio management software for registered investment advisers, data aggregation, enrichment capabilities, and individual investor platform. The Morningstar Credit segment includes credit ratings, research, data, and credit analytics solutions that contribute to the transparency of international and domestic credit markets. The Morningstar Retirement segment offers products designed to help individuals reach retirement goals. The company was founded by Joseph D. Mansueto on May 16, 1984, and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.industry_zh: 財務數據和證券交易所
info.description_zh: Morningstar, Inc. 從事提供投資研究。它提供晨星數據、直接、投資管理、顧問工作站、工作場所解決方案、宣傳冊數據、企業組件、研究、信用評級和指數。它透過以下部門運作：晨星數據和分析部門、PitchBook部門、晨星財富部門、晨星信貸部門、晨星退休部門以及企業和所有其他部門。晨星數據和分析部門致力於為投資者提供數據、研究和見解以及投資分析，以促進投資決策。 PitchBook 部門專注於為投資者提供涵蓋私人資本市場的廣泛數據和研究，包括風險投資、私募股權、私人信貸和銀行貸款以及併購活動。晨星財富部門是指模型投資組合和財富平台、註冊投資顧問的實踐和投資組合管理軟體、資料聚合、豐富能力和個人投資者平台。晨星信貸部門包括信用評級、研究、數據和信用分析解決方案，有助於提高國際和國內信貸市場的透明度。晨星退休部門提供旨在幫助個人實現退休目標的產品。該公司由 Joseph D. Mansueto 於 1984 年 5 月 16 日創立，總部位於伊利諾州芝加哥。

info.description: Siebert Financial Corp. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of brokerage and financial advisory services. It conducts the following lines of business through wholly owned subsidiaries: Retail Brokerage Business, Investment Advisory Services, Insurance Services, Robo-Advisory Technology Development, and Prime Brokerage Services. The company was founded by Siebert Muriel F. on April 9, 1934 and is headquartered in Miami Beach, FL.
info.description_zh: Siebert Financial Corp. 是一家銀行控股公司，從事提供經紀和財務諮詢服務。它透過全資子公司開展以下業務：零售經紀業務、投資諮詢服務、保險服務、機器人諮詢技術開發和大宗經紀服務。該公司由 Siebert Muriel F. 於 1934 年 4 月 9 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密海灘。

info.description: Arrivent Biopharma, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in identifying, licensing, and globalizing biopharma innovations from around the world to deliver important medicines to patients. The company was founded Zheng Bin Yao and Stuart Lutzker on April 14, 2021 and is headquartered in Newtown Square, PA.
info.description_zh: Arrivent Biopharma, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於識別、許可和全球化世界各地的生物製藥創新，為患者提供重要的藥物。該公司由鄭斌姚和斯圖爾特·盧茨克於 2021 年 4 月 14 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州紐敦廣場。

info.description: Century Aluminum Co. is a producer of aluminum and operates aluminum reduction facilities, or smelters, in the United States and Iceland. Its products include standard ingots, T-ingot, extrusion billet, horizontal direct chill ingot, molten, slab, and sow. The company was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: Century Aluminium Co. 是一家鋁生產商，在美國和冰島經營鋁還原設施或冶煉廠。其產品包括標準鋼錠、T型鋼錠、擠壓鋼坯、水平直冷鋼錠、熔煉鋼錠、板坯和母材。該公司成立於 1995 年，總部位於伊利諾州芝加哥。

info.description: Ishares Copper And Metals Mining ETF seeks to track the investment results of the STOXX Global Copper and Metals Mining Index composed of U.S. and non-U.S. equities of companies primarily engaged in copper and metal ore mining. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its underlying index and may invest up to 20% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Ishares 銅和金屬礦業 ETF 旨在追蹤 STOXX 全球銅和金屬礦業指數的投資結果，該指數由主要從事銅和金屬礦石開採的公司的美國和非美國股票組成。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其標的指數的組成證券以及具有與其標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資，並可能將最多 20% 的資產投資於某些期貨、期權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: IPG Photonics Corp. engages in the provision of design, development, production and distribution of fiber lasers, laser systems, fiber amplifiers, and related optical components. Its products include lasers, beam delivery, medical, telecom equipment, product finder and components such as pump diodes, chillers, and mid-IR crystals. The company was founded by Valentin P. Gapontsev and Igor Samartsev in 1990 and is headquartered in Marlborough, MA.
info.description_zh: IPG Photonics Corp. 從事光纖雷射、雷射系統、光纖放大器和相關光學元件的設計、開發、生產和分銷。其產品包括雷射、光束傳輸、醫療、電信設備、產品查找器以及泵浦二極體、冷卻器和中紅外線晶體等組件。該公司由 Valentin P. Gapontsev 和 Igor Samartsev 於 1990 年創立，總部位於麻薩諸塞州馬爾伯勒。

info.description: Mustang Bio, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the translation of medical breakthroughs in cell and gene therapies into potential cures for hematologic cancers, solid tumors, and rare genetic diseases. Its pipeline includes CAR T therapies for hematologic malignancies, CAR T therapies for solid tumors, and gene therapies for rare genetic disorders. The company was founded on March 13, 2015 and is headquartered in Waltham, MA.
info.description_zh: Mustang Bio, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於將細胞和基因療法的醫學突破轉化為血液癌症、實體瘤和罕見遺傳疾病的潛在療法。其產品線包括針對血液惡性腫瘤的 CAR T 療法、針對實體瘤的 CAR T 療法以及針對罕見遺傳性疾病的基因療法。該公司成立於2015年3月13日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州沃爾瑟姆。

info.description: Big Digital Energy, Inc. engages in the provision of digital asset infrastructure services. The company was founded on February 10, 2012 and is headquartered in Midland, PA.
info.description_zh: Big Digital Energy, Inc.從事提供數位資產基礎設施服務。該公司成立於2012年2月10日，總部位於賓州米德蘭市。

info.description: BlackLine, Inc. engages in providing a cloud-based software platform that automates and controls financial close and accounting processes. It operates through the United States and International geographical segments. The company was founded by Therese Tucker in May 2001 and is headquartered in Woodland Hills, CA.
info.description_zh: BlackLine, Inc. 致力於提供基於雲端的軟體平台，可自動執行和控制財務結算和會計流程。它透過美國和國際地理部門開展業務。該公司由 Therese Tucker 於 2001 年 5 月創立，總部位於加州伍德蘭希爾斯。

info.description: Criteo SA is a global technology company, which specializes in digital performance marketing. The firm enables e-commerce companies to leverage large volumes of granular data to engage and convert their customers. It operates through the following segments: Marketing Solutions, Retail Media, and Iponweb. The Marketing Solutions segment is involved in helping advertisers achieve their customer acquisition and retention goals. The Retail Media segment assists retailers in generating high-margin advertising revenues from brands and agencies looking to address multiple marketing goals. The iponweb segment specializes in building real-time advertising technology and trading infrastructure, delivering advanced media buying, selling, and packaging capabilities for media owners, agencies, performance advertisers, and third-party AdTech platforms. The company was founded by Jean-Baptiste Rudelle, Franck Le Ouay, Pascal Gauthier, Laurent Quatrefages and Romain Niccoli on November 3, 2005 and is headquartered in Paris, France.
info.description_zh: Criteo SA 是一家專注於數位效果行銷的全球科技公司。該公司使電子商務公司能夠利用大量精細數據來吸引和轉換客戶。它透過以下部門運作：行銷解決方案部門、零售媒體部門和 Iponweb 部門。行銷解決方案部門致力於幫助廣告商實現其客戶獲取和保留目標。零售媒體部門幫助零售商從尋求實現多種行銷目標的品牌和代理商那裡獲得高利潤的廣告收入。 iponweb 部門專注於建立即時廣告技術和交易基礎設施，為媒體所有者、代理商、效果廣告商和第三方 AdTech 平台提供先進的媒體購買、銷售和打包功能。該公司由 Jean-Baptiste Rudelle、Franck Le Ouay、Pascal Gauthier、Laurent Quatrefages 和 Romain Niccoli 於 2005 年 11 月 3 日創立，總部位於法國巴黎。

info.description: ProFrac Holding Corp. engages in the provision of hydraulic fracturing, proppant production, and other completion services. It operates through the following segments: Stimulation Services, Proppant Production, Manufacturing, and Other. The Stimulation Services segment owns a fleet of mobile hydraulic fracturing units and other auxiliary equipment that generates revenue by providing stimulation services to customers. The Proppant Production segment focuses on the provision of proppant to oilfield service providers and exploration and production companies. The Manufacturing segment is involved in the sale of products such as horsepower pumps, valves, piping, swivels, large-bore manifold systems, and fluid ends. The Other segment refers to Flotek Industries and Livewire Power, LLC. The company was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Willow Park, TX.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣設備與服務
info.description_zh: ProFrac Holding Corp. 從事提供水力壓裂、支撐劑生產和其他完井服務。它透過以下部門運作：增產服務部門、支撐劑生產部門、製造部門和其他部門。增產服務部門擁有一批行動水力壓裂裝置和其他輔助設備，透過向客戶提供增產服務來創造收入。支撐劑生產部門專注於向油田服務提供者以及勘探和生產公司提供支撐劑。製造部門從事馬力幫浦、閥門、管路、旋轉接頭、大口徑歧管系統和流體端等產品的銷售。其他部門是指 Flotek Industries 和 Livewire Power, LLC。該公司成立於 2016 年，總部位於德克薩斯州威洛帕克。

info.description: Quanterix Corp. engages in the development of ultra-sensitive digital immunoassay platform that advances precision health for life sciences research and diagnostics. Its products and services include Simoa Assay Kits, HD-X analyzer, SR-X Biomarker Detection System, SP-X Imaging and Analysis System, 2470 Arrayer, Simoa Accelerator Laboratory, Uman NF-Light, and Homebrew -Custom Assay Development. The company was founded by Nicholas J. Naclerio and David R. Walt in April 2007 and is headquartered in Billerica, MA.
info.description_zh: Quanterix Corp. 致力於開發超靈敏數位免疫分析平台，促進生命科學研究和診斷的精準健康。其產品和服務包括 Simoa 檢測試劑盒、HD-X 分析儀、SR-X 生物標記檢測系統、SP-X 成像和分析系統、2470 陣列儀、Simoa 加速器實驗室、Uman NF-Light 和 Homebrew - 客製化檢測開發。該公司由 Nicholas J. Naclerio 和 David R. Walt 於 2007 年 4 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州比勒里卡。

info.description: Fiserv, Inc. engages in the provision of financial services technology. It operates through the Merchant and Financial segments. The Merchant segment offers commerce-enabling products and services including merchant acquiring and digital commerce and mobile payment services, and security and fraud protection, stored-value, and pay-by-bank solutions to companies of all sizes. The Financial segment provides products and services such as processing of customer loan and deposit accounts, digital payments, and card transactions to financial institutions and corporate and public sector clients. The company was founded by Leslie M. Muma and George D. Dalton on July 31, 1984 and is headquartered in Milwaukee, WI.
info.description_zh: Fiserv, Inc. 從事提供金融服務技術。它透過商業和金融部門運作。商家部門為各種規模的公司提供商業支援產品和服務，包括商家收單、數位商務和行動支付服務，以及安全和詐欺保護、儲值和銀行支付解決方案。金融部門向金融機構以及企業和公共部門客戶提供客戶貸款和存款帳戶處理、數位支付和卡片交易等產品和服務。該公司由 Leslie M. Muma 和 George D. Dalton 於 1984 年 7 月 31 日創立，總部位於威斯康辛州密爾瓦基。

info.description: Freeport-McMoRan, Inc. engages in the mining of copper, gold, and molybdenum. It operates through the following segments: U.S. Copper Mines, South America Operations, Indonesia Operations, Molybdenum Mines, U.S. Rod and Refining, Atlantic Copper, and Corporate and Other. The U.S. Copper Mines segment operates open-pit copper mines in Morenci, Bagdad, Safford, Sierrita, Miami in Arizona and Chino, and Tyrone in New Mexico. The South America Operations segment includes Cerro Verde in Peru and El Abra in Chile. The Indonesia Operations segment handles the operations of the Grasberg minerals district that produce copper concentrate containing significant quantities of gold and silver. The Molybdenum Mines segment includes the Henderson underground mine and Climax open pit mine, both in Colorado. The U.S. Rod and Refining segment consists of copper conversion facilities located in North America and includes refinery and rod mills. The Atlantic Copper segment smelts and refines copper concentrate and markets refined copper and precious metals in slimes. The Corporate and Other segment offers other mining and eliminations, oil and gas operations, and other corporate and elimination items. The company was founded by James R. Moffett on November 10, 1987, and is headquartered in Phoenix, AZ.
info.description_zh: Freeport-McMoRan, Inc. 從事銅、金和鉬的開採。該公司透過以下部門運作：美國銅礦部門、南美業務部門、印尼業務部門、鉬礦部門、美國棒材和精煉部門、大西洋銅業部門以及企業及其他部門。美國銅礦部門在亞利桑那州的莫倫西、巴格達、薩福德、謝里塔、邁阿密和新墨西哥州的奇諾和蒂龍經營露天銅礦。南美洲業務部門包括秘魯的Cerro Verde 和智利的El Abra。印尼業務部門負責格拉斯伯格礦區的業務，該礦區生產含有大量金和銀的銅精礦。鉬礦部門包括位於科羅拉多州的亨德森地下礦和 Climax 露天礦場。美國棒材和精煉部門由位於北美的銅轉化設施組成，包括精煉廠和棒材軋鋼機。大西洋銅業部門冶煉和精煉銅精礦，並銷售精煉銅和礦泥中的貴金屬。公司及其他部門提供其他採礦和消除、石油和天然氣業務以及其他公司和消除項目。該公司由 James R. Moffett 於 1987 年 11 月 10 日創立，總部位於亞利桑那州菲尼克斯。

info.description: Veeva Systems, Inc. engages in the provision of industry cloud solutions for the global life sciences industry. The firm's solutions enable pharmaceutical and other life sciences companies to realize the benefits of modern cloud-based architectures and mobile applications for their most critical business functions, without compromising industry-specific functionality or regulatory compliance. Its customer relationship management solutions enable its customers to increase the productivity and compliance of their sales and marketing functions. The firm's regulated content management and collaboration solutions enable its customers to more efficiently manage regulated, content-centric processes across the enterprise. Its customer master solution enables customers to more effectively manage complex healthcare provider and healthcare organization data. The company was founded by Mark Armenante, Peter P. Gassner, Doug Ostler, Mitch Wallace and Matthew J. Wallach on January 12, 2007 and is headquartered in Pleasanton, CA.
info.description_zh: Veeva Systems, Inc. 致力於為全球生命科學產業提供產業雲端解決方案。該公司的解決方案使製藥和其他生命科學公司能夠實現現代基於雲端的架構和行動應用程式對其最關鍵業務功能的好處，而不會影響行業特定的功能或法規遵循。其客戶關係管理解決方案使客戶能夠提高其銷售和行銷職能的生產力和合規性。該公司的受監管內容管理和協作解決方案使其客戶能夠更有效地管理整個企業受監管、以內容為中心的流程。其客戶主解決方案使客戶能夠更有效地管理複雜的醫療保健提供者和醫療保健組織資料。該公司由 Mark Armenante、Peter P. Gassner、Doug Ostler、Mitch Wallace 和 Matthew J. Wallach 於 2007 年 1 月 12 日創立，總部位於加州普萊森頓。

info.description: CuriosityStream, Inc. is a media and entertainment company. It offers video and audio programming across the principal categories of factual entertainment, including science, history, society, nature, lifestyle, and technology. The company was founded by John S. Hendricks on June 06, 2008 and is headquartered in Silver Spring, MD.
info.description_zh: CuriosityStream, Inc. 是一家媒體和娛樂公司。它提供橫跨事實娛樂主要類別的視訊和音訊節目，包括科學、歷史、社會、自然、生活方式和技術。該公司由 John S. Hendricks 於 2008 年 6 月 6 日創立，總部位於馬裡蘭州銀泉。

info.description: Marqeta, Inc. engages in the creation of digital payment technology. The firm develops a modern card issuing platform, providing infrastructure and tools for building configurable payment cards. It provides its customers issuer processor services and also acts as a card program manager. The company was founded by Jason M. Gardner in 2010 and is headquartered in Oakland, CA.
info.description_zh: Marqeta, Inc. 致力於數位支付技術的創建。該公司開發了一個現代化的發卡平台，為建立可配置的支付卡提供基礎設施和工具。它為其客戶提供發卡機構服務並充當卡程序管理器。該公司由 Jason M. Gardner 於 2010 年創立，總部位於加州奧克蘭。

info.description: Sprott Active Metals & Miners ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund, which is actively managed, seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets in equity securities of (i) companies that are engaged in the mining, exploration, production, development, distribution or recycling of metals and raw materials that frequently are used to support growing global demand for energy and (ii) royalty and streaming companies engaged in financing such metals and raw materials. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Sprott Active Metals & Miners ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。該基金採用主動管理方式，在正常情況下，力求透過將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於 (i) 從事金屬和原材料採礦、勘探、生產、開發、分銷或回收的公司的股本證券來實現其投資目標，這些金屬和原材料經常用於支持全球不斷增長的能源需求，以及 (ii) 從事為此類金屬和原材料的特許經營權。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Pacific Biosciences of California, Inc. engages in the development, manufacture, and marketing of advanced sequencing solutions for genetic analysis. It operates through the following geographical segments: America, Europe, Middle East, and Africa, and Asia Pacific. The company was founded by Stephen Turner and Joseph Vincent Bonventre on July 14, 2000 and is headquartered in Menlo Park, CA.
info.description_zh: Pacific Biosciences of California, Inc. 從事遺傳分析的先進定序解決方案的開發、製造和行銷。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美洲、歐洲、中東、非洲以及亞太地區。該公司由 Stephen Turner 和 Joseph Vincent Bonventre 於 2000 年 7 月 14 日創立，總部位於加州門洛帕克。

info.description: Allot Ltd. engages in the provision of network intelligence and security solutions. The firm's solutions turn network, application, usage, and security data into intelligence. Its products include Allot Secure, Allot Smart, Application Control Gateway, DDoS Secure, and NFV Compliant. The company was founded by Yigal Jacoby and Michael Shurman on November 12, 1996 and is headquartered in Hod-Hasharon, Israel.
info.description_zh: Allot Ltd. 從事提供網路智慧和安全解決方案。該公司的解決方案將網路、應用程式、使用情況和安全資料轉化為情報。其產品包括 Allot Secure、Allot Smart、應用程式控制網關、DDoS Secure 和 NFV Compliant。該公司由 Yigal Jacoby 和 Michael Shurman 於 1996 年 11 月 12 日創立，總部位於以色列 Hod-Hasharon。

info.description: Relay Therapeutics, Inc. engages in transforming the drug discovery process with an initial focus on enhancing small molecule therapeutic discovery in targeted oncology. Its Dynamo platform is use to integrate an array of edge experimental and computational approaches, which allows to apply the understanding of protein structure and motion to drug discovery. The company was founded by David Elliot Shaw, Matthew P. Jacobson, Dorothee Kern, Mark Murcko, Alexis Borisy, and Jakob Loven on May 4, 2015 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Relay Therapeutics, Inc. 致力於改變藥物發現過程，最初的重點是增強靶向腫瘤學中的小分子治療發現。其 Dynamo 平台用於整合一系列邊緣實驗和計算方法，從而可以將對蛋白質結構和運動的理解應用於藥物發現。該公司由 David Elliot Shaw、Matthew P. Jacobson、Dorothee Kern、Mark Murcko、Alexis Borisy 和 Jakob Loven 於 2015 年 5 月 4 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: XTI Aerospace, Inc. engages in the provision of aircraft manufacturing. The firm primarily focuses on the light and mid-size business aircraft market. It operates through the following segments: Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS) and Commercial Aviation. The UAS segment provides comprehensive drone solutions to enterprise, government, and defense clients. The Commercial Aviation segment focuses on development of the TriFan 600 VTOL aircraft through research and engineering activities. The company was founded in April 1999 and is headquartered in Addison, TX.
info.description_zh: XTI Aerospace, Inc. 從事飛機製造。該公司主要專注於輕型和中型公務飛機市場。它透過以下部門運作：無人機系統（UAS）和商業航空。 UAS 部門為企業、政府和國防客戶提供全面的無人機解決方案。商業航空部門專注於透過研究和工程活動開發 TriFan 600 VTOL 飛機。該公司成立於 1999 年 4 月，總部位於德克薩斯州艾迪生。

info.description: Karyopharm Therapeutics, Inc. is a commercial-stage pharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery, development, and commercialization of drugs directed against nuclear export for the treatment of cancer and other diseases. The company was founded by Joseph Araujo, Ronald A. DePinho, Pamela A. Silver, Giulio Draetta, Michael G. Kauffman, and Sharon Shacham on December 22, 2008 and is headquartered in Newton, MA.
info.description_zh: Karyopharm Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家商業階段的製藥公司，致力於發現、開發和商業化針對核輸出的藥物，用於治療癌症和其他疾病。該公司由 Joseph Araujo、Ronald A. DePinho、Pamela A. Silver、Giulio Draetta、Michael G. Kauffman 和 Sharon Shacham 於 2008 年 12 月 22 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州牛頓。

info.description: Edgewise Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company. It focuses on the discovery, development and commercialization of innovative treatments for severe, rare muscle disorders for which there is significant unmet medical need. Its platform utilizes custom-built throughput and translatable systems that measure integrated muscle function in whole organ extracts to identify small molecule precision medicines regulating key proteins in muscle tissue, initially focused on addressing rare neuromuscular and cardiac diseases. The company was founded by Badreddin Edris, Alan Russel and Peter A. Thompson in 2017 and is headquartered in Boulder, CO.
info.description_zh: Edgewise Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司。它專注於針對嚴重、罕見肌肉疾病的創新療法的發現、開發和商業化，這些疾病的醫療需求尚未得到滿足。其平台利用定制的通量和可翻譯系統來測量整個器官提取物中的綜合肌肉功能，以識別調節肌肉組織中關鍵蛋白質的小分子精準藥物，最初專注於解決罕見的神經肌肉和心臟病。該公司由 Badreddin Edris、Alan Russel 和 Peter A. Thompson 於 2017 年創立，總部位於科羅拉多州博爾德。

info.description: Sprout Social, Inc. engages in the provision of online social media management tools for businesses. It offers communication tools, contact management, lead generation, and analytics services. The firm also offers solutions for enterprises, agencies, small businesses, customer service, social media marketing, and employee advocacy sectors. The company was founded by Justyn Howard, Aaron Rankin, Gilbert Lara, and Peter Soung on April 21, 2010 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: Sprout Social, Inc. 致力於為企業提供線上社群媒體管理工具。它提供通訊工具、聯絡人管理、潛在客戶開發和分析服務。該公司也為企業、機構、小型企業、客戶服務、社群媒體行銷和員工倡導領域提供解決方案。該公司由 Justyn Howard、Aaron Rankin、Gilbert Lara 和 Peter Soung 於 2010 年 4 月 21 日創立，總部位於伊利諾伊州芝加哥。

info.description: Repay Holdings Corp. engages in the provision of integrated payment processing solutions to vertical markets that have specific and bespoke transactions. It offers payments, instant funding, active safe, AP automation, clearing and settlement, messaging management, STX mortgage transfer automation, virtual debit cards, and value-added services. The firm operates through the Consumer Payments and Business Payments segments. The Consumer Payments segment provides solutions such as debit and credit card processing, ACH processing and other electronic payment acceptance solutions. The Business Payments segment provides payment processing solutions, which includes accounts payable automation, debit and credit card processing, virtual credit card processing, ACH processing and other electronic payment acceptance solutions The company was founded by John Morris and Shaler A. Alias in 2006 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: Repay Holdings Corp. 致力於為具有特定和客製化交易的垂直市場提供整合支付處理解決方案。它提供支付、即時資金、主動安全、AP自動化、清算和結算、訊息管理、STX抵押轉帳自動化、虛擬借記卡和增值服務。該公司透過消費者支付和商業支付部門運作。消費者支付部門提供金融卡和信用卡處理、ACH 處理和其他電子支付受理解決方案等解決方案。商業支付部門提供支付處理解決方案，包括應付帳款自動化、金融卡和信用卡處理、虛擬信用卡處理、ACH 處理和其他電子支付受理解決方案。該公司由 John Morris 和 Shaler A. Alias 於 2006 年創立，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: EVgo, Inc. engages in the provision of electric vehicle charging station services. It offers the EVgo network, home charging solutions, work charging solutions, and freedom station plans to electric car owners. The company was founded in October 2010 and is headquartered in El Segundo, CA.
info.description_zh: EVgo, Inc. 從事提供電動車充電站服務。它為電動車車主提供 EVgo 網路、家庭充電解決方案、工作充電解決方案和自由站計劃。該公司成立於 2010 年 10 月，總部位於加州埃爾塞貢多。

info.description: Sprott Junior Copper Miners ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond generally to the total return performance of the Nasdaq Sprott Junior Copper Miners Index. The fund will, under normal circumstances, invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities of the index. The index is designed to track the performance of companies that derive at least 50% of their revenue and/or assets from mining, exploration, development, and production of copper. The index generally consists of from 25 to 45 constituents. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Sprott 初級銅礦 ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支之前的投資結果，該結果通常與納斯達克 Sprott 初級銅礦指數的總回報表現相對應。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的總資產投資於該指數的證券。該指數旨在追蹤至少 50% 的收入和/或資產來自銅礦開採、勘探、開發和生產的公司的表現。該指數通常由 25 至 45 隻成分股組成。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Sprott Energy Transition Materials ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond generally to the total return performance of the Nasdaq Sprott Energy Transition Materials Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in securities of the index. The index is designed to track the performance of companies that derive at least 50% of their revenue and/or assets from (i) mining, exploration, development, production, recycling, refining, or smelting of energy transition materials; (ii) investments in energy transition materials that represent all or a significant portion of their assets. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Sprott 能源轉型材料 ETF 尋求提供扣除費用和開支先前的投資結果，該結果通常與納斯達克 Sprott 能源轉型材料指數的總回報表現相對應。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於該指數的證券。該指數旨在追蹤至少 50% 收入和/或資產來自 (i) 能源轉型材料的採礦、勘探、開發、生產、回收、精煉或冶煉的公司的業績； (ii) 代表其全部或大部分資產的能源轉型材料投資。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Greenpro Capital Corp. engages in the provision of business solution services to small and medium-size enterprises. It operates through the following business segments: Service Business, Digital Business, and Real Estate Business. The Service Business segment offers advisory and business solution services. The Digital Business segment focuses on the digital platform and trading of digital assets. The Real Estate Business segment trades or leases commercial real estate properties in Hong Kong and Malaysia. The company was founded by Lee Chong Kuang on July 19, 2013 and is headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
info.description_zh: 綠專資本致力於為中小企業提供商業解決方案服務。它透過以下業務部門運作：服務業務、數位業務和房地產業務。服務業務部門提供諮詢和業務解決方案服務。數位業務部門專注於數位平台和數位資產交易。房地產業務部門在香港和馬來西亞交易或租賃商業房地產。該公司由李宗光於2013年7月19日創立，總部位於馬來西亞吉隆坡。

info.description: Sprott Rare Earths Ex-China ETF is a non-diversified exchange-traded fund that provides targeted, "pure-play" exposure to the global rare earths industry while specifically excluding companies domiciled in or primarily operating within China. The fund tracks an index of companies involved in the mining, separation, refining, and production of rare earth elements (REEs), catering to investors seeking to capitalize on the geopolitical realignment of critical material supply chains.
info.description_zh: Sprott Rare Earths Ex-China ETF 是一款非多元化交易所交易基金，提供針對全球稀土行業的有針對性的「純粹」投資，同時明確排除在中國註冊或主要在中國運營的公司。該基金追蹤參與稀土元素 (REE) 開採、分離、精煉和生產的公司指數，迎合尋求利用關鍵材料供應鏈地緣政治重組的投資者。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long XPEV Daily ETF is an actively managed fund targeting 200% of the daily performance of the common stock of XPeng Inc. (XPEV). The strategy is a tactical instrument for sophisticated traders, utilizing financial derivatives to provide magnified daily exposure to the underlying Chinese smart electric vehicle company.
info.description_zh: Leverage Shares 2X Long XPEV Daily ETF 是一支主動式管理基金，目標投資於小鵬汽車 (XPEV) 普通股每日表現的 200%。該策略是成熟交易者的戰術工具，利用金融衍生性商品來擴大對中國智慧電動汽車公司的日常曝險。

info.description: Alkami Technology, Inc. engages in the provision of digital banking software solutions to credit unions, banks, credit union service organizations, and service bureaus. It offers content management and an online and mobile banking suite that brings together a snapshot view of accounts with recent and upcoming activities. The company was founded by Louis A. Iannaccone, Scott Klososky, Steve Meston, Gary L. Nelson, Gruenewald Bobby, Jay Lackey, Stephen Bohanon, and Kim Stroh in 2007 and is headquartered in Plano, TX.
info.description_zh: Alkami Technology, Inc. 致力於向信用社、銀行、信用社服務組織和服務局提供數位銀行軟體解決方案。它提供內容管理以及線上和行動銀行套件，將帳戶快照視圖與最近和即將進行的活動結合在一起。該公司由 Louis A. Iannaccone、Scott Klososky、Steve Meston、Gary L. Nelson、Gruenewald Bobby、Jay Lackey、Stephen Bohanon 和 Kim Stroh 於 2007 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州普萊諾。

info.description: American Resources Corp. engages in the extraction, processing, transportation, and distribution of metallurgical coal to the steel industry. It focuses on the operation of coal mining complexes located primarily within Pike, Knott, and Letcher Counties, Kentucky, and Wyoming County, West Virginia. The company was founded in 2006 and in headquartered in Fishers, IN.
info.description_zh: 美國資源公司從事冶金煤的開採、加工、運輸和分配給鋼鐵業。該公司專注於主要位於肯塔基州派克縣、諾特縣和萊徹縣以及西維吉尼亞州懷俄明縣的煤礦綜合體的運作。該公司成立於 2006 年，總部位於印第安納州費希爾斯。

info.description: Canadian Solar, Inc. engages in the manufacture of solar photovoltaic modules, provision of solar energy and battery storage solutions, and development of utility-scale solar and battery storage products. It operates through the CSI Solar and Global Energy segments. The CSI Solar segment designs, develops, and manufactures solar ingots, wafers, cells, modules, and other solar power and battery storage products. The Global Energy segment includes solar and battery storage project development and sale, asset management services for operational projects, sale of electricity, and investment in retained assets. The company was founded by Shawn Qu in October 2001 and is headquartered in Kitchener, Canada.
info.description_zh: 阿特斯陽光電力有限公司從事太陽能光伏組件製造、提供太陽能和電池儲存解決方案以及開發公用事業規模太陽能和電池儲存產品。它透過 CSI Solar 和 Global Energy 部門運作。 CSI Solar部門設計、開發和製造太陽能錠、矽片、電池、模組以及其他太陽能和電池儲存產品。全球能源部門包括太陽能和電池儲存項目的開發和銷售、營運項目的資產管理服務、電力銷售以及保留資產的投資。該公司由Shawn Qu於2001年10月創立，總部位於加拿大基奇納。

info.description: WeRide, Inc. operates as an investment holding company. It engages in the sale of autonomous driving vehicles, primarily including robobuses, robotaxis, robosweepers and related sensor suites. The company was founded by Tony Xu Han and Yan Li in February 2017 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
info.description_zh: 文遠知行文遠知行以投資控股公司經營。它從事自動駕駛車輛的銷售，主要包括機器人公車、機器人計程車、機器人掃地機和相關感測器套件。該公司由Tony Xu Han和Yan Li於2017年2月創立，總部位於中國廣州。

info.description: NioCorp Developments Ltd. engages in the evaluation, acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral deposits. It focuses on a super alloy materials project in Nebraska for producing niobium, scandium, and titanium. The company was founded on February 27, 1987, and is headquartered in Centennial, CO.
info.description_zh: NioCorp Developments Ltd. 從事礦藏的評估、收購、勘探和開發。它專注於內布拉斯加州的一個生產鈮、鈧和鈦的超級合金材料項目。該公司成立於1987年2月27日，總部位於科羅拉多州森特尼爾。

info.description: Upland Software, Inc. engages in providing cloud-based software applications. Its products include AccuRoute, Adestra, Altify, BA Insight, Cimpl, ComSci, Eclipse PPM, FileBound, InGenius, Intelligent Capture, InterFAX, Kapost, Localytics, Mobile Commons, Objectif Lune, Panviva, PostUp, PowerStreering, PSA, Qvidian, Rant and Rave, RightAnswers, RO Innovation, Second Street, Ultriva, and Waterfall. The company was founded by John T. McDonald in July 2010 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: Upland Software, Inc. 致力於提供基於雲端的軟體應用程式。其產品包括 AccuRoute、Adestra、Altify、BA Insight、Cimpl、ComSci、Eclipse PPM、FileBound、InGenius、Intelligent Capture、InterFAX、Kapost、Localytics、Mobile Commons、Objectif Lune、Panviva、PostUp、PowerStreering、Localytics、Mobile Commons、Objectif Lune、Panviva、PostUp. Waterfall。該公司由 John T. McDonald 於 2010 年 7 月創立，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: CEA Industries, Inc. engages in in the development, design, and distribution of cultivation technologies for controlled environment agriculture, primarily for cannabis crops. It offers controlled climate systems, controls, and biosecurity cultivation products, and MEP engineering, odor control, and installation support services. The company was founded by Brandy Marie Keen and Stephen Keen on October 15, 2009 and is headquartered in Louisville, CO.
info.description_zh: CEA Industries, Inc. 從事受控環境農業（主要針對大麻作物）種植技術的開發、設計和分銷。它提供受控氣候系統、控制和生物安全栽培產品，以及機電工程、氣味控制和安裝支援服務。該公司由 Brandy Marie Keen 和 Stephen Keen 於 2009 年 10 月 15 日創立，總部位於科羅拉多州路易斯維爾。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long LAC Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of LAC. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of LAC, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 LAC 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 LAC 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來提供 LAC 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long USAR Daily ETF is an actively managed fund targeting 200% of the daily performance of the common stock of USA Rare Earth, Inc. (USAR). The strategy is a tactical instrument for sophisticated traders, utilizing financial derivatives to provide magnified daily exposure to the underlying company involved in the critical minerals supply chain.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 USAR 每日 ETF 是一檔主動管理基金，目標是 USA Rare Earth, Inc. (USAR) 普通股每日表現的 200%。該策略是經驗豐富的交易者的戰術工具，利用金融衍生性商品為參與關鍵礦產供應鏈的基礎公司提供放大的每日風險敞口。

info.description: Sadot Group, Inc. operates as a restaurant chain business. It operates through the following segments: Muscle Maker Grill Restaurant, Pokemoto Hawaiian Poke Restaurant, Non-Traditional (Hybrid), SuperFit Foods Meal Prep, and Sadot. The firm offers protein- based meals featuring chicken, seafood, pasta, hamburgers, wraps and flat breads. It also provides salads, protein shakes and fruit smoothies. The company was founded by Rodney C. Silva in 2022 and is headquartered in Burleson, TX.
info.description_zh: Sadot Group, Inc. 是一家連鎖餐廳企業。它透過以下部門運作：Muscle Maker Grill Restaurant、Pokemoto Hawaiian Poke Restaurant、非傳統（混合）、SuperFit Foods Meal Prep 和 Sadot。該公司提供蛋白質食品，包括雞肉、海鮮、義大利麵、漢堡、捲餅和扁麵包。它還提供沙拉、蛋白奶昔和水果冰沙。該公司由 Rodney C. Silva 於 2022 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州伯利森。

info.description: Laser Photonics Corp. engages in the business of manufacturing, research, and development of industrial laser technologies and systems. The firm offers operations that enable customers to reduce development and advanced laser equipment manufacturing time, achieve better pricing, maintain quality control, and protect proprietary know-how and technology compared to other laser cleaning companies and competing technologies. The company was founded on November 8, 2019 and is headquartered in Lake Mary, FL.

info.description_zh: Laser Photonics Corp. 從事工業雷射技術和系統的製造、研究和開發業務。與其他雷射清潔公司和競爭技術相比，該公司提供的業務使客戶能夠減少開發和先進雷射設備的製造時間、實現更好的定價、保持品質控制並保護專有知識和技術。該公司成立於2019年11月8日，總部位於佛羅裡達州瑪麗湖。

info.description: Solidion Technology, Inc. engages in researching, developing and manufacturing battery components and materials, batteries and related energy storage products for the automotive electric vehicle and other markets. The company was founded on June 30, 2023 and is headquartered in Dallas, TX.
info.description_zh: Solidion Technology, Inc.從事汽車電動車及其他市場的電池組件和材料、電池及相關儲能產品的研究、開發和製造。該公司成立於2023年6月30日，總部位於德州達拉斯。

info.description: Eastern International Ltd. operates as a holding company. It engages in the provision of logistic services for entities. It operates through the Transportation Services and Warehouse Subleasing Services segments. The Transportation Services segment includes project logistic, cross border logistic, and basic logistic. The company was founded on July 27, 2023 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.
info.description_zh: 東方國際有限公司作為一家控股公司運作。它從事為實體提供物流服務。它透過運輸服務和倉庫轉租服務部門運作。運輸服務部門包括專案物流、跨境物流和基礎物流。公司成立於2023年7月27日，總部位於中國杭州。

info.description: Hang Feng Technology Innovation Co., Ltd. is a holding company which engages in the provision of corporate management consulting and asset management services. Its business consists of two main segments: corporate management consulting services and asset management services. The firm provides following services through its subsidiaries: Management consulting, Regulatory compliance and governance consulting. Its asset management services include: fund subscription and fund management services. The company was founded on October 15, 2024 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: 航峰科技創新有限公司是一家從事提供企業管理顧問和資產管理服務的控股公司。其業務包括兩個主要板塊：企業管理諮詢服務和資產管理服務。該公司透過其子公司提供以下服務：管理諮詢、監管合規和治理諮詢。其資產管理服務包括：基金認購及基金管理服務。該公司成立於2024年10月15日，總部位於香港。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Short MSTR ETF seeks daily inverse investment results, before fees and expenses, of -2.0 times (-200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of MSTR. The fund advisor has adopted a policy to have at least 80% of its investment exposure to financial instruments with economic characteristics that should provide 2 times the inverse exposure to the daily performance of the underlying security. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2X Short MSTR ETF 尋求每日反向投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 MSTR 股價每日百分比變化的 -2.0 倍（-200%）。基金顧問已採取一項政策，將其至少 80% 的投資敞口投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具應為基礎證券的日常表現提供 2 倍的反向敞口。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Stabilis Solutions, Inc. is an energy transition company, which engages in providing turnkey clean energy production, storage, transportation, and fueling solutions. It also builds power and control systems for the energy industry in China. The company was founded by J. Casey Crenshaw on October 21, 1996 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: Stabilis Solutions, Inc. 是一家能源轉型公司，致力於提供統包清潔能源生產、儲存、運輸和燃料加註解決方案。它也為中國的能源產業建造電力和控制系統。該公司由 J. Casey Crenshaw 於 1996 年 10 月 21 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州休斯頓。

info.description: Turbo Energy SA provides energy solutions. It engages in the developing, manufacturing and distributing of photovoltaic products. The company was founded on September 18, 2013 and is headquartered in Valencia, Spain.
info.description_zh: Turbo Energy SA 提供能源解決方案。它從事光伏產品的開發、製造和銷售。該公司成立於2013年9月18日，總部位於西班牙巴倫西亞。

info.description: Concrete Pumping Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of waste management solutions and services. It operates through the following segments: U.S. Concrete Pumping, U.S. Concrete Waste Management Services, and the U.K. Operations. The U.S. Concrete Pumping segment includes services under the Brundage-Bone and Capital Pumping trade names. The U.S. Concrete Waste Management Services segment is involved in the pans and containers rented to customers and the disposal services under the Eco-Pan trade name. The U.K. Operations segment relates to the concrete pumping services and leasing of concrete pumping equipment to customers under the Camfaud Concrete Pumps and Premier Concrete Pumping trade names. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Thornton, CO.
info.description_zh: Concrete Pumping Holdings, Inc. 從事提供廢棄物管理解決方案和服務。它透過以下部門運作：美國混凝土泵送部門、美國混凝土廢棄物管理服務部門和英國營運部門。美國混凝土泵送部門包括以 Brundage-Bone 和 Capital Pumping 商標名稱提供的服務。美國混凝土廢棄物管理服務部門提供向客戶出租的盤子和容器以及以 Eco-Pan 商標名稱提供的處置服務。英國營運部門涉及混凝土泵送服務以及以 Camfaud Concrete Pumps 和 Premier Concrete Pumping 商標名向客戶租賃混凝土泵送設備。該公司成立於 1983 年，總部位於科羅拉多州桑頓。

info.description: Universal Logistics Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of customized transportation and logistics solutions. It operates through the following segments: Contract Logistics, Intermodal, and Trucking. The Contract Logistics segment provides local and regional drayage services coordinated through company-managed terminals. The Intermodal segment provides local and regional drayage services coordinated through company-managed terminals. The Trucking segment includes dry van, flatbed, heavy-haul, and refrigerated operations, transporting a broad range of commodities including automotive parts, machinery, building materials, food products, steel, and other industrial and consumer goods. The company was founded in 1932 and is headquartered in Warren, MI.
info.description_zh: Universal Logistics Holdings, Inc. 從事提供客製化運輸和物流解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：合約物流、多式聯運和卡車運輸。合約物流部門透過公司管理的碼頭提供協調的本地和區域拖運服務。多式聯運部門透過公司管理的碼頭提供協調的本地和區域拖運服務。卡車運輸部門包括乾貨車、平板車、重載和冷藏業務，運輸各種商品，包括汽車零件、機械、建築材料、食品、鋼鐵以及其他工業和消費品。該公司成立於 1932 年，總部位於密西根州沃倫。

info.description: MVB Financial Corp. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of community and mortgage banking services. It operates through the following segments: CoRe Banking, Mortgage Banking, and Financial Holding Company. The CoRe Banking segment includes the Fintech division, which represents banking products and services offered to customers by the bank, primarily loans and deposits accounts. The Mortgage Banking segment focuses on the share of net income or loss from mortgage banking activities of equity method investments in ICM and Warp Speed. The Financial Holding Company segment refers to the intercompany service income and dividends. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Fairmont, WV.
info.description_zh: MVB Financial Corp. 是一家控股公司，從事提供社區和抵押銀行服務。它透過以下部門運作：核心銀行部門、抵押銀行部門和金融控股公司部門。核心銀行業務部門包括金融科技部門，該部門代表銀行向客戶提供的銀行產品和服務，主要是貸款和存款帳戶。抵押銀行業務部門專注於 ICM 和 Warp Speed 權益法投資的抵押銀行業務淨收入或虧損份額。金融控股公司分部是指公司間服務收入及股利。該公司成立於 1999 年，總部位於西維吉尼亞州費爾蒙特。

info.description: Lifecore Biomedical, Inc. engages in the development and manufacturing of pharmaceuticals products and services. It focuses on selling products utilizing hyaluronan, a naturally occurring polysaccharide that is widely distributed in the extracellular matrix of connective tissues in both animals and humans, and non-HA products for medical use primarily in the Ophthalmic, Orthopedic and other markets. The company was founded by Otto Sartorius in 1965 and is headquartered in Chaska, MN.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Lifecore Biomedical, Inc. 從事醫藥產品和服務的開發和製造。該公司專注於銷售利用透明質酸的產品，透明質酸是一種天然存在的多醣，廣泛分佈於動物和人類結締組織的細胞外基質中，以及主要用於眼科、骨科和其他市場的非透明質酸產品。該公司由 Otto Sartorius 於 1965 年創立，總部位於明尼蘇達州查斯卡。

info.description: Smart Sand, Inc. engages in supplying frac sand and related services. The firm offers complete mine to wellsite proppant supply and logistics solutions. It operates through the Sand and SmartSystems segments. The Sand segment includes both frac sand sales and IPS sales. The SmartSystems segment focuses on the rental of patented SmartSystems equipment and related services provided to customers. The company was founded by Charles E. Young on July 19, 2011 and is headquartered in Yardley, PA.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣設備與服務
info.description_zh: Smart Sand, Inc. 從事供應壓裂砂及相關服務。該公司提供完整的礦山到井場支撐劑供應和物流解決方案。它透過 Sand 和 SmartSystems 部門運作。砂子部門包括壓裂砂銷售和 IPS 銷售。 SmartSystems 部門專注於向客戶提供專利的 SmartSystems 設備的租賃和相關服務。該公司由 Charles E. Young 於 2011 年 7 月 19 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州亞德利。

info.description: Wells Fargo & Co. is a diversified and community-based financial services company, which engages in the provision of banking, insurance, investments, mortgage, and consumer and commercial finance products and services. It operates through the following segments: Consumer Banking and Lending, Commercial Banking, Corporate and Investment Banking, and Wealth and Investment Management. The Consumer Banking and Lending segment offers consumer and small business banking, home lending, credit cards, auto, and personal lending. The Commercial Banking segment provides banking and credit products across industry sectors and municipalities, secured lending and lease products, and treasury management. The Corporate and Investment Banking segment is composed of corporate banking, investment banking, treasury management, commercial real estate lending and servicing, and equity and fixed income solutions, as well as sales, trading, and research capabilities. The Wealth and Investment Management segment refers to personalized wealth management, brokerage, financial planning, lending, private banking, trust, and fiduciary products and services. The company was founded by Henry Wells and William G. Fargo on March 18, 1852 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: 富國銀行是一家多元化、以社區為基礎的金融服務公司，從事提供銀行、保險、投資、抵押貸款以及消費者和商業金融產品和服務。它透過以下部門運作：消費者銀行和貸款部門、商業銀行部門、企業和投資銀行部門以及財富和投資管理部門。消費者銀行和貸款部門提供消費者和小型企業銀行業務、房屋貸款、信用卡、汽車和個人貸款。商業銀行部門提供跨行業和市政當局的銀行和信貸產品、擔保貸款和租賃產品以及資金管理。企業和投資銀行部門由企業銀行、投資銀行、資金管理、商業房地產貸款和服務、股票和固定收益解決方案以及銷售、交易和研究能力組成。財富與投資管理部門指個人化財富管理、經紀、財務規劃、貸款、私人銀行、信託和信託產品和服務。該公司由 Henry Wells 和 William G. Fargo 於 1852 年 3 月 18 日創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州舊金山。

info.description: Eagle Financial Services, Inc. operates as a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of retail and commercial banking services, demand, savings and time deposits, consumer, mortgage and commercial loans. It offers telephone banking, internet banking, and mobile banking to its customers. The company was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Berryville, VA.
info.description_zh: Eagle Financial Services, Inc. 以銀行控股公司經營，從事提供零售和商業銀行服務、活期存款、儲蓄和定期存款、消費者貸款、抵押貸款和商業貸款。它為客戶提供電話銀行、網路銀行和手機銀行。該公司成立於 1991 年，總部位於維吉尼亞州貝裡維爾。

info.description: Sentage Holdings, Inc. engages in the financial services, which offers a comprehensive range of financial services across consumer loan repayment and collection management, loan recommendation, and prepaid payment network services in China. The company was founded on September 16, 2019 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: Sentage Holdings, Inc.從事金融服務業務，在中國提供涵蓋消費貸款還款和催收管理、貸款推薦以及預付支付網路服務等全方位的金融服務。公司成立於2019年9月16日，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: Capital Bancorp, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of commercial and consumer banking services through its subsidiary, Capital Bank, NA. It operates through the following segments: Commercial Banking, Capital Bank Home Loans, OpenSky, Windsor Advantage, and Corporate. The Commercial Banking segment provides personalized service to commercial clients throughout the Washington, D.C. and Baltimore metropolitan areas. The Capital Bank Home Loans segment represents the company's mortgage loan division. The OpenSky segment refers to the credit card division. The Windsor Advantage segment provides loan services that offer community banks and credit unions a comprehensive outsourced SBA and USDA lending platform. The Corporate segment includes non-recurring expenses, merger-related expenses, and operational expenses. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Rockville, MD.
info.description_zh: Capital Bancorp, Inc. 是一家控股公司，透過其子公司 Capital Bank, NA 提供商業和消費者銀行服務。它透過以下部門運作：商業銀行部門、資本銀行房屋貸款部門、OpenSky、Windsor Advantage 部門和企業部門。商業銀行部門為華盛頓特區和巴爾的摩大都會區的商業客戶提供個人化服務。 Capital Bank 房屋貸款部門代表該公司的抵押貸款部門。 OpenSky 部門是指信用卡部門。 Windsor Advantage 部門提供貸款服務，為社區銀行和信用合作社提供全面的外包 SBA 和 USDA 貸款平台。公司部門包括非經常性費用、合併相關費用和營運費用。該公司成立於 1988 年，總部位於馬裡蘭州羅克維爾。

info.description: Preferred Bank engages in offering financial services. Its services include demand, time, and savings deposits, and real estate, business, and consumer lending. The company was founded by Li Yu on September 9, 1991 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.
info.description_zh: 優先銀行從事提供金融服務。其服務包括活期存款、定期存款和儲蓄存款，以及房地產、商業和消費貸款。該公司由李宇於1991年9月9日創立，總部位於加州洛杉磯。

info.description: Peoples Bancorp of North Carolina, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the business of owning the Bank, Peoples Bank and PEBK Capital Trust II. It operates through the following segments: Banking Operations, Community Bank Real Estate Solutions, LLC (CBRES), and Other. The Banking Operations segment focuses on the consolidated bank. The CBRES segment provides appraisal management services to community banks. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Newton, NC.
info.description_zh: Peoples Bancorp of North Carolina, Inc. 是一家控股公司，從事控股銀行、Peoples Bank 和 PEBK Capital Trust II 業務。它透過以下部門運作：銀行業務部門、社區銀行房地產解決方案有限責任公司（CBRES）和其他部門。銀行業務部門專注於合併銀行。 CBRES 部門為社區銀行提供評估管理服務。該公司成立於 1999 年，總部位於北卡羅來納州牛頓。

info.description: Vivos Therapeutics, Inc. is a medical technology company which engages in the development and commercialization of treatment alternatives for patients with sleep disordered breathing (SDB). Its solutions are also offered for patients with mild-to-moderate obstructive sleep apnea (OSA). The company was founded by Gurdev Dave Singh, Susan McCullough, RaeAnn Byrnes, Todd Huntsman, and R. Kirk Huntsman on July 7, 2016 and is headquartered in Littleton, CO.
info.description_zh: Vivos Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家醫療技術公司，致力於睡眠呼吸障礙 (SDB) 患者治療替代方案的開發和商業化。其解決方案也為輕度至中度阻塞性睡眠呼吸中止症 (OSA) 患者提供。該公司由 Gurdev Dave Singh、Susan McCullough、RaeAnn Byrnes、Todd Huntsman 和 R. Kirk Huntsman 於 2016 年 7 月 7 日創立，總部位於科羅拉多州利特爾頓。

info.description: First Business Financial Services, Inc. operates as a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of commercial banking services. It offers treasury and investment management, commercial lending, equipment finance, retirement plans, trust and estate administration, private banking and asset-based lending. The company was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Madison, WI.
info.description_zh: First Business Financial Services, Inc. 作為銀行控股公司經營，提供商業銀行服務。它提供財務和投資管理、商業貸款、設備融資、退休計劃、信託和遺產管理、私人銀行和資產貸款。該公司成立於 1986 年，總部位於威斯康辛州麥迪遜。

info.description: First Trust NASDAQ ABA Community Bank Index Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ OMX ABA Community Bank TM Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to track the performance of small, mid and large capitalization companies that comprise the community banking industry.
info.description_zh: First Trust NASDAQ ABA Community Bank Index Fund 尋求的投資結果通常與名為 NASDAQ OMX ABA Community Bank TM Index 的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在追蹤社區銀行業中小型、中型和大型資本公司的表現。

info.description: Ames National Corp. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of banking services through its subsidiaries. Its activities include personal, business, agricultural and commercial lending, management of the investment securities portfolio, deposit account services, and wealth management services. The company was founded on January 21, 1975 and is headquartered in Ames, IA.
info.description_zh: Ames National Corp. 是一家銀行控股公司，透過其子公司提供銀行服務。其業務包括個人、企業、農業和商業貸款、投資證券組合管理、存款帳戶服務和財富管理服務。該公司成立於 1975 年 1 月 21 日，總部位於愛荷華州艾姆斯。

info.description: Ligand Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company that involves clinical development and commercialization of high-value medicines. Its platforms, Captisol and NITRICI, offer technology with broad applicability in drug development to a large network of biopharmaceutical partners, including the largest pharmaceutical manufacturers in the world. The company was founded by Ronald M. Evans in 1987 and is headquartered in Jupiter, FL.
info.description_zh: Ligand Pharmaceuticals, Inc.是一家生物製藥公司，涉及高價值藥物的臨床開發和商業化。其 Captisol 和 NITRICI 平台為包括世界上最大的製藥製造商在內的大型生物製藥合作夥伴網路提供在藥物開發方面具有廣泛適用性的技術。該公司由 Ronald M. Evans 於 1987 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州朱庇特。

info.description: Fifth Third Bancorp is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of diversified financial services. It operates through the following segments: Commercial Banking, Consumer and Small Business Banking, and Wealth and Asset Management. The Commercial Banking segment offers credit intermediation, cash management, and financial services to large and middle-market businesses and government and professional customers. The Consumer and Small Business Banking segment provides a full range of deposit and loan products to individuals and small businesses through a network of full-service banking centers and relationships with indirect and correspondent loan originators in addition to providing products designed to meet the specific needs of small businesses, including cash management services. The Wealth and Asset Management segment provides wealth management solutions for individuals, companies, and not-for-profit organizations including wealth planning, investment management, banking, insurance, trust, and estate services. The company was founded on October 7, 1974 and is headquartered in Cincinnati, OH.
info.description_zh: Fifth Third Bancorp是一家銀行控股公司，從事提供多元化金融服務。它透過以下部門運作：商業銀行部門、消費者和小型企業銀行部門以及財富和資產管理部門。商業銀行部門為大中型市場企業以及政府和專業客戶提供信貸中介、現金管理和金融服務。消費者和小型企業銀行部門透過全方位服務銀行中心網路以及與間接和代理貸款發起人的關係，向個人和小型企業提供全方位的存款和貸款產品，此外還提供旨在滿足小型企業特定需求的產品，包括現金管理服務。財富與資產管理部門為個人、公司和非營利組織提供財富管理解決方案，包括財富規劃、投資管理、銀行、保險、信託和房地產服務。該公司成立於 1974 年 10 月 7 日，總部位於俄亥俄州辛辛那提。

info.description: ITHAX Acquisition Corp. III is a blank check company. It was formed to effect a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on July 3, 2025 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: ITHAX Acquisition Corp. III 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立是為了與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年7月3日，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: ProShares UltraShort Top QQQ seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times the inverse (-2x) of the daily performance of the Nasdaq-100 Mega Index. The fund invests in financial instruments that ProShare Advisors believes, in combination, should produce daily returns consistent with the Daily Target. The index is designed to measure the performance of the largest companies included in the Nasdaq-100 Index by targeting the performance of approximately the top 45% cumulative weight of the Nasdaq-100 Index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ProShares UltraShort Top QQQ 尋求扣除費用和支出之前的每日投資結果，該結果相當於 Nasdaq-100 Mega Index 每日表現的倒數 (-2x) 的兩倍。該基金投資於 ProShare Advisors 認為綜合起來應產生與每日目標一致的每日回報的金融工具。該指數旨在透過納斯達克 100 指數中約前 45% 累積權重的表現來衡量納斯達克 100 指數中最大的公司的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares 2031 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco BulletShares Municipal Bond 2031 Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade municipal bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities," in the year 2031 (collectively, "2031 Bonds"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares 2031 市政債券 ETF 旨在追蹤 Invesco BulletShares 市政債券 2031 指數（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數旨在衡量 2031 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級市政債券（在某些情況下為「有效到期日」）投資組合的表現（統稱為「2031 年債券」）。該基金是非多元化的。

Laverne in July 2004 and is headquartered in Walnut Creek, CA.

info.description: iTonic Holdings Ltd. operates as a holding company with interests in providing healthcare solutions. The firm through its subsidiaries engages in the development and commercialization of brachytherapy TPS specifically used for radioactive particle implantation, a type of radiotherapy used in treating cancer patients by placing radioactive sources inside the patient that kill cancer cells and shrink tumors. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.

info.description: SUNation Energy, Inc. is focused on local and regional solar, storage, and energy services companies nationwide. The firm's vision is to power the energy transition through the grass-roots growth of solar electricity paired with battery storage. Its portfolio of brands, including SUNation, Hawaii Energy Connection, E-Gear, Sungevity, and Horizon Solar Power, provides homeowners and small businesses with an end-to-end product offering spanning solar, battery storage, and grid services. The company was founded in 1969 and is headquartered in Ronkonkoma, NY.
info.description_zh: SUNation Energy, Inc. 專注於全國各地的本地和區域太陽能、儲存和能源服務公司。該公司的願景是透過太陽能發電與電池儲存相結合的基層成長來推動能源轉型。其品牌組合包括 SUNation、Hawaii Energy Connection、E-Gear、Sungevity 和 Horizo​​n Solar Power，為房主和小型企業提供涵蓋太陽能、電池儲存和電網服務的端到端產品。該公司成立於 1969 年，總部位於紐約州朗康科馬。

Hawkins III 和 William Gordon 於 1982 年創立，總部位於加州雷德伍德市。
