The company was founded by August James Troendle in 1992 and is headquartered in Cincinnati, OH.
info.description_zh: Medpace Holdings, Inc. 致力於為生物技術、製藥和醫療器材產業提供外包臨床開發服務。該公司的服務包括醫療部門、臨床試驗管理、數據驅動的可行性、研究啟動、臨床監測、監管事務、患者招募和保留、醫學寫作、生物識別和數據科學、藥物警戒、核心實驗室、實驗室、診所和品質保證。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、歐洲、比利時、亞太地區和其他地區。該公司由 August James Troendle 於 1992 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州辛辛那提。

info.description: First Trust Nasdaq Pharmaceuticals ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of the Nasdaq US Smart Pharmaceuticals IndexTM. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks and depository receipts that comprise the index. The index is designed to provide exposure to U.S. companies comprising the pharmaceutical sector that have been selected based upon their liquidity and weighted based upon their cumulative score on three investing factors: volatility, value and growth. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust Nasdaq Pharmaceuticals ETF 尋求與納斯達克美國智能製藥指數TM 的價格和收益率（基金費用和開支之前）大致相對應的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。該指數旨在提供對包括製藥業在內的美國公司的投資，這些公司是根據其流動性進行選擇的，並根據其在三個投資因素（波動性、價值和增長）的累積得分進行加權。它是非多元化的。

info.description: OneIM Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on September 05, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: OneIM Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年9月5日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: The Cooper Cos, Inc. operates as a medical device company. It operates through the Cooper Vision and Cooper Surgical segments. The Cooper Vision segment develops, manufactures, and markets products for contact lens wearers, which solves vision challenges such as astigmatism, presbyopia, myopia, ocular dryness, and eye fatigues. The Cooper Surgical segment focuses on the provision of advancement for the health of women, babies, and families through women's health and fertility products and services. The company was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in San Ramon, CA.
info.description_zh: Cooper Cos, Inc. 是一家醫療器材公司。它透過 Cooper Vision 和 Cooper Surgical 部門運作。 Cooper Vision 部門為隱形眼鏡配戴者開發、製造和銷售產品，解決散光、老花眼、近視、眼乾澀和眼睛疲勞等視力挑戰。 Cooper Surgical 部門專注於透過婦女健康和生育產品和服務促進婦女、嬰兒和家庭的健康。該公司成立於 1958 年，總部位於加州聖拉蒙。

info.description: NCS Multistage Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of engineered products and services that facilitate the optimization of oil and natural gas well completions and field development strategies. It offers fracturing systems, repeat precision, tracer diagnostics, and well construction. The company was founded by Robert Nipper and Marty Stromquist in 2006 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣設備與服務
info.description_zh: NCS Multistage Holdings, Inc. 從事提供工程產品和服務，以促進石油和天然氣完井和油田開發策略的最佳化。它提供壓裂系統、重複精度、示踪劑診斷和建井。該公司由 Robert Nipper 和 Marty Stromquist 於 2006 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州休斯頓。

info.description: Bogota Financial Corp. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of business activities that are permissible for mutual holding companies under New Jersey law, including investing in loans and securities. It also focuses on the acquisition of banking and financial services companies. The firm operates through the following loan portfolio segments: residential first mortgage, commercial and multi-family real estate, construction, home equity and other, and commercial and industrial. The company was founded in September 2019 and is headquartered in Teaneck, NJ.
info.description_zh: 波哥大金融公司是一家控股公司，從事提供新澤西州法律允許的共同控股公司的業務活動，包括投資貸款和證券。它還專注於收購銀行和金融服務公司。該公司透過以下貸款組合部門運作：住宅第一抵押貸款、商業和多戶房地產、建築、房屋淨值及其他以及商業和工業。該公司成立於 2019 年 9 月，總部位於新澤西州蒂內克。

info.description: Bio-Techne Corp. is a global life sciences company providing innovative tools and bioactive reagents for research and clinical diagnostic communities. Its products assist scientific investigations into biological processes and the nature and progress of specific diseases. It operates through the Protein Sciences, and Diagnostics and Spatial Biology segments. The Protein Sciences segment develops and manufactures purified proteins, and reagent solutions. The Diagnostics and Spatial Biology segment develops and manufactures diagnostic products. The company was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Minneapolis, MN.
info.description_zh: Bio-Techne Corp. 是一家全球生命科學公司，為研究和臨床診斷界提供創新工具和生物活性試劑。其產品有助於對生物過程以及特定疾病的性質和進展進行科學研究。它透過蛋白質科學、診斷和空間生物學部門運作。蛋白質科學部門開發和製造純化蛋白質和試劑溶液。診斷和空間生物學部門開發和製造診斷產品。該公司成立於 1976 年，總部位於明尼蘇達州明尼阿波利斯。

info.description: Stoneport Advisors Commodity Long Short ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the Stoneport Advisors Dynamic Commodity Index - Total Return. The fund invests both long and short, in highly liquid U.S. exchange-listed physical commodity futures contracts that are contained in the index or that have characteristics that the Adviser believes make their return performance likely to be highly correlated to futures contracts that are contained in the index. The index is a rules-based, quantitative, long-short commodity futures index comprised of liquid, U.S. exchange-listed physical commodity futures contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Stoneport Advisors 商品多空 ETF 旨在追蹤 Stoneport Advisors 動態商品指數 - 總回報（未計費用和開支）的表現。該基金對流動性高的美國交易所上市實體商品期貨合約進行多頭和空頭投資，這些期貨合約包含在指數中，或具有顧問認為其回報表現可能與指數中包含的期貨合約高度相關的特徵。該指數是一種基於規則的定量多空商品期貨指數，由流動性強、在美國交易所上市的實體商品期貨合約組成。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: BRP, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the design, development, manufacture, distribution, and marketing of power sports vehicles and marine products. The firm operates through the Powersports and Marine segments. The Powersports segment includes year-round products, seasonal products and powersports PA&A and OEM Engines. The Marine segment includes outboard and jet boat engines, boats, and related PA&A and other services. Its brands include Ski-Doo, Lynx, Sea-Doo, Evinrude, Rotax, Can-Am, and Alumacraft. The company was founded on May 1, 2003 and is headquartered in Valcourt, Canada.
info.description_zh: BRP, Inc. 是一家控股公司，從事動力運動車輛和船用產品的設計、開發、製造、分銷和行銷。該公司透過動力運動和海洋部門運作。 Powersports 部門包括全年產品、季節性產品以及 Powersports PA&A 和 OEM 引擎。船舶部門包括舷外機和噴射船發動機、船舶以及相關的 PA&A 和其他服務。其品牌包括 Ski-Doo、Lynx、Sea-Doo、Evinrude、Rotax、Can-Am 和 Alumacraft。該公司成立於2003年5月1日，總部位於加拿大瓦爾考特。

info.description: Matrix Service Co. engages in the provision of engineering, fabrication, construction, and maintenance services to support critical energy infrastructure and industrial markets. It operates through the following segments: Storage and Terminal Solutions, Utility and Power Infrastructure, and Process and Industrial Facilities. The Storage and Terminal Solutions segment is related to cryogenic and other specialty tanks and terminals for LNG, NGLs, hydrogen, ammonia, propane, butane, liquid nitrogen/liquid oxygen, and liquid petroleum. The Utility and Power Infrastructure segment refers to LNG utility peak shaving facilities. The Process and Industrial Facilities segment is focused on plant maintenance, repair, and turnarounds in the downstream and midstream markets for energy clients including refining and processing of crude oil, fractionating, and marketing of natural gas and natural gas liquids. The company was founded by Bill Lee, Doyl D. West, Harold Morgan, and Martin Lee Rinehart on April 4, 1984, and is headquartered in Tulsa, OK.
info.description_zh: Matrix Service Co. 從事提供工程、製造、施工和維護服務，以支援關鍵能源基礎設施和工業市場。該公司透過以下部門運作：儲存和終端解決方案部門、公用事業和電力基礎設施部門以及流程和工業設施部門。儲存和終端解決方案部門涉及液化天然氣、液化天然氣、氫氣、氨、丙烷、丁烷、液態氮/液態氧和液態石油的低溫和其他特殊儲槽和終端。公用事業和電力基礎設施部門是指液化天然氣公用事業調峰設施。流程和工業設施部門專注於為能源客戶提供下游和中游市場的工廠維護、維修和周轉服務，包括原油精煉和加工、天然氣和液化天然氣的分餾和行銷。該公司由 Bill Lee、Doyl D. West、Harold Morgan 和 Martin Lee Rinehart 於 1984 年 4 月 4 日創立，總部位於俄克拉荷馬州塔爾薩。

info.description: DirectBooking Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the provision of transportation services through its subsidiary, Primega Construction. Its services include soil and rock transportation, diesel oil trading, and construction works such as excavation and lateral support works and bored piling. The company was founded on April 14, 2022 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: DirectBooking Technology Co., Ltd. 透過其子公司 Primega Construction 提供運輸服務。其服務包括土壤和岩石運輸、柴油貿易以及挖掘和橫向支撐工程以及鑽孔打樁等建築工程。該公司成立於2022年4月14日，總部位於香港。

info.description: Guru Favorite Stocks ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund's investment strategy is to seek to grow the capital by investing in high quality companies that are favored by prominent long-term investors ("Gurus") and at reasonable prices. The fund's investment sub-adviser, GuruFocus Investments, LLC (the "Sub-Adviser") tracks the equity portfolio holdings of approximately twenty Gurus. To be considered a Guru, the investor must have a long-term, publicly available, track record of at least ten years. In addition, the Guru must follow an investment strategy of investing in companies that the Guru considers to be high-quality.
info.description_zh: Guru 最愛股票 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金的投資策略是透過投資於受著名長期投資者（「大師」）青睞且價格合理的優質公司來尋求資本增長。該基金的投資副顧問 GuruFocus Investments, LLC（「副顧問」）追蹤約 20 位 Guru 的股票投資組合持有情況。要被視為大師，投資者必須擁有至少十年的長期、公開的追蹤記錄。此外，Guru 必須遵循投資 Guru 認為高品質的公司的投資策略。

info.description: Wynn Resorts Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the design, development, and operation of destination casino resorts. It operates through the following segments: Wynn Palace, Wynn Macau, Las Vegas Operations, Encore Boston Harbor, and Corporate and Other. The company was founded by Stephen Alan Wynn, Elaine P. Wynn, and Kazuo Okada in 2002 and is headquartered in Las Vegas, NV.
info.description_zh: 永利度假村有限公司是一家控股公司，從事目的地賭場度假村的設計、開發和營運。該公司透過以下部門運作：永利皇宮部門、永利澳門部門、拉斯維加斯業務部門、安可波士頓港部門以及企業及其他部門。該公司由 Stephen Alan Wynn、Elaine P. Wynn 和 Kazuo Okada 於 2002 年創立，總部位於內華達州拉斯維加斯。

info.description: BNB Plus Corp. is a biotechnology company, which engages in the development and commercialization of technologies to produce and detect deoxyribonucleic acid and ribonucleic acid. It operates through the following segments: Therapeutic DNA Production Services, MDx Testing Services, and DNA Tagging and Security Products and Services. The Therapeutic DNA Production Services segment consists of the enzymatic manufacture of synthetic DNA for use in the production of nucleic acid-based therapeutics and the development and sale of a proprietary RNAP for use in the production of mRNA therapeutics. The MDx Testing Services segment develops clinical molecular diagnostic and genetic tests and clinical laboratory testing services. The DNA Tagging and Security Products and Services segment is involved in the detection of DNA for industrial supply chains and security services. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Stony Brook, NY.
info.description_zh: BNB Plus Corp.是一家生物技術公司，從事脫氧核糖核酸和核糖核酸生產和檢測技術的開發和商業化。該公司透過以下部門運作：治療性 DNA 生產服務、MDx 測試服務以及 DNA 標記和安全產品及服務。治療性 DNA 生產服務部門包括用於生產基於核酸的治療劑的合成 DNA 的酶促生產，以及用於生產 mRNA 治療劑的專有 RNAP 的開發和銷售。 MDx 測試服務部門開發臨床分子診斷和基因測試以及臨床實驗室測試服務。 DNA 標籤和安全產品及服務部門涉及工業供應鏈和安全服務的 DNA 檢測。該公司成立於 1983 年，總部位於紐約州石溪。

info.description: VersaBank engages in the provision of financial services. It operates through Digital Banking and DRTC. The Digital Banking segment offers business to business model using its financial technoolgy to address issues in the U.S. banking market. The DRTC segment refers to developed IT security software and capabilities. The company was founded by David Roy Taylor on January 18, 1993 and is headquartered in London, Canada.
info.description_zh: VersaBank 從事提供金融服務。它透過數位銀行和 DRTC 運作。數位銀行部門利用其金融科技提供企業對企業模式來解決美國銀行市場的問題。 DRTC 部分是指開發的 IT 安全軟體和功能。該公司由David Roy Taylor於1993年1月18日創立，總部位於加拿大倫敦。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST MU ETF is an actively managed ETF designed to generate high levels of monthly and weekly income. The fund primarily employs an options-based strategy, selling put options on a leveraged ETF that tracks Micron Technology, Inc. (MU). By selling these options, the fund seeks to capture premium income, with secondary objectives of gaining exposure to the performance of the underlying leveraged ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST MU ETF 是一款主動管理的 ETF，旨在產生高水準的月度和周收入。該基金主要採用基於選擇權的策略，出售追蹤美光科技 (MU) 的槓桿 ETF 的看跌期權。透過出售這些選擇權，該基金尋求獲取溢價收入，次要目標是獲得基礎槓桿 ETF 績效的曝險，但須遵守潛在投資收益的上限。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST CRWV ETF  is an actively managed ETF designed to generate high levels of monthly and weekly income. The fund primarily employs an options-based strategy, selling put options on a leveraged ETF that tracks CoreWeave, Inc. (CRWV). By selling these options, the fund seeks to capture premium income, with secondary objectives of gaining exposure to the underlying security while managing potential downside through a specific volatility-linked framework.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST CRWV ETF 是一款主動管理的 ETF，旨在產生高水準的月度和周收入。該基金主要採用基於選擇權的策略，出售追蹤 CoreWeave, Inc. (CRWV) 的槓桿 ETF 的看跌選擇權。透過出售這些選擇權，該基金尋求獲取溢價收入，次要目標是獲得基礎證券的敞口，同時透過特定的波動性相關框架管理潛在的下行風險。

info.description: Rocky Brands, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, and marketing of footwear and apparel. Its brands include Rocky, Georgia Boot, Durango, Lehigh, and Michelin. It operates through the following segments: Wholesale, Retail, and Contract Manufacturing. The Wholesale segment distributes products through retail stores. The Retail segment includes direct sales of products to consumers through e-commerce websites, third party marketplaces, and Rocky outlet stores. The Contract Manufacturing segment focuses on wholesale, retail business and footwear contracts with the U.S. military. The company was founded in 1932 and is headquartered in Nelsonville, OH.
info.description_zh: Rocky Brands, Inc. 從事鞋類和服裝的設計、製造和行銷。其品牌包括 Rocky、Georgia Boot、Durango、Lehigh 和 Michelin。它透過以下部門運作：批發、零售和合約製造。批發部門透過零售店分銷產品。零售部門包括透過電子商務網站、第三方市場和 Rocky 直銷店直接向消費者銷售產品。合約製造部門專注於批發、零售業務以及與美國軍方的鞋類合約。該公司成立於 1932 年，總部位於俄亥俄州尼爾森維爾。

info.description: Graniteshares YieldBOOST Meta ETF seeks current income; exposure to the performance of one or more exchange-traded funds whose shares trade on a U.S.-regulated securities exchange and that seek daily leverage investment results of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage of the common stock of Meta Platforms, Inc. Class A (NASDAQ: META) subject to a limit on potential investment gains. The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in derivatives contracts that utilize the Underlying META ETF as the reference asset. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Graniteshares YieldBOOST Meta ETF 尋求當前收入；暴露於一隻或多只交易所交易基金的表現，這些基金的股票在美國監管的證券交易所進行交易，並且尋求每日槓桿投資結果為 Meta Platforms, Inc. A 類（納斯達克股票代碼：META）普通每日百分比的 2 倍（200%），但受到潛在投資收益股票的限制。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於利用基礎 META ETF 作為參考資產的衍生性合約。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco Electric Vehicle Metals Commodity Strategy No K-1 ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that, under normal circumstances, seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in a combination of financial instruments that are economically linked to the tradeable metals widely used in the production of an electric vehicle (which include, but are not limited to, iron ore, copper, aluminum, nickel, cobalt and lithium). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 景順電動車金屬商品策略No K-1 ETF尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），在正常情況下，尋求透過投資與電動車生產中廣泛使用的可交易金屬（包括但不限於鐵礦石、銅、鋁、鎳、鈷和鋰）經濟相關的金融工具組合來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Calamos Strategic Total Return Fund is a closed ended balanced mutual fund launched by Calamos Investments LLC. The fund is managed by Calamos Advisors LLC. It invests in the public equity and fixed income markets of the United States. The fund seeks to invest in securities of companies operating across diversified sectors. It primarily invests in common and preferred stocks of companies across all market capitalizations, convertible securities, and high yield corporate bonds with an average credit rating of BB as rated by S&P. The fund employs both fundamental and quantitative analysis with a combination of bottom-up and top-down security picking approaches to create its portfolio. Calamos Strategic Total Return Fund was formed on December 31, 2003 and is domiciled in the United States.
info.description_zh: Calamos 策略總回報基金是 Calamos Investments LLC 推出的封閉式平衡共同基金。該基金由 Calamos Advisors LLC 管理。它投資於美國的公共股權和固定收益市場。該基金尋求投資於多元化產業運營的公司的證券。它主要投資於所有市值公司的普通股和優先股、可轉換證券以及標準普爾平均信用評級為BB的高收益公司債。本基金採用基本面分析和定量分析，並結合自下而上和自上而下的證券選擇方法來創建投資組合。 Calamos 策略總回報基金成立於 2003 年 12 月 31 日，註冊地為美國。

info.description: Xtrackers RREEF Global Natural Resources ETF seeks total return from both capital appreciation and current income. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes (calculated at the time of any investment), in securities of companies in the natural resources sector. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Xtrackers RREEF 全球自然資源 ETF 尋求資本增值和當前收入的總回報。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產，加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額（在任何投資時計算）投資於自然資源產業公司的證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: IRIDEX Corp. engages in developing, manufacturing, and marketing medical systems, delivery devices, and consumable instrumentation for the ophthalmology market. Its products include lasers, laser delivery and glaucoma devices, retinal surgical instruments, veterinary, and ENT. The company was founded by Eduardo Arias, Theodore A. Boutacoff, David M. Buzawa and James L. Donovan in February 1989 and is headquartered in Mountain View, CA.
info.description_zh: IRIDEX Corp. 從事眼科市場醫療系統、輸送設備和消耗性儀器的開發、製造和行銷。其產品包括雷射、雷射傳輸和青光眼設備、視網膜手術器械、獸醫和耳鼻喉科器械。該公司由 Eduardo Arias、Theodore A. Boutacoff、David M. Buzawa 和 James L. Donovan 於 1989 年 2 月創立，總部位於加州山景城。

info.description: QuidelOrtho Corp. operates as a vitro diagnostics company. It is focused on developing and manufacturing diagnostic products. The company was founded on May 27, 2022 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: QuidelOrtho Corp. 是一家體外診斷公司。它專注於開發和製造診斷產品。該公司成立於2022年5月27日，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

info.description: Greenland Technologies Holding Corp. engages in the manufacture of drivetrain systems for material handling machineries and electric vehicles, as well as electric industrial vehicles. Its products include the GEF-series electric forklifts, a series of lithium-powered forklifts with three models ranging in size from 1.8 tons to 3.5 tons, and GEL-1800, a 1.8 ton rated load lithium-powered electric wheeled front loader and GEX-8000, an all-electric 8.0 ton rated load lithium-powered wheeled excavator. The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in East Windsor, NJ.
info.description_zh: 格陵蘭科技控股公司從事物料搬運機械和電動汽車以及電動工業車輛傳動系統的製造。產品包括GEF系列電動堆高機、1.8噸至3.5噸三種型號的鋰動力堆高機、1.8噸額定載重鋰動力電動輪式裝載機GEL-1800及8.0噸額定載重全電動鋰動力輪式挖土機GEX-8000。該公司成立於 2006 年，總部位於新澤西州東溫莎。

info.description: Trinity Biotech Plc engages in the development, manufacture, and marketing of medical diagnostic products for the clinical laboratory and point-of-care segments of the diagnostic market. It operates through the Americas and Rest of World geographical segments. The company was founded by Ronan O'Caoimh and Denis R. Burger in June 1992 and is headquartered in Bray, Ireland.
info.description_zh: Trinity Biotech Plc 從事臨床實驗室和診斷市場即時護理領域的醫療診斷產品的開發、製造和行銷。它透過美洲和世界其他地區的地理部分開展業務。該公司由 Ronan O'Caoimh 和 Denis R. Burger 於 1992 年 6 月創立，總部位於愛爾蘭布雷。

info.description: The Descartes Systems Group, Inc. engages in the provision of on-demand, software-as-a-service solutions focused on improving the productivity, performance and security of logistics-intensive businesses. It uses modular, software-as-a-service solutions to route, schedule, track and measure delivery resources; plan, allocate and execute shipments; rate, audit and pay transportation invoices; access global trade data; file customs and security documents for imports and exports; and complete numerous other logistics processes by participating in the world's largest, collaborative multimodal logistics community. The company was founded on May 22, 1981 and is headquartered in Waterloo, Canada.
info.description_zh: Descartes Systems Group, Inc. 致力於提供按需軟體即服務解決方案，專注於提升物流密集型企業的生產力、效能和安全性。它使用模組化的軟體即服務解決方案來路由、調度、追蹤和測量交付資源；計劃、分配和執行運輸；評估、審核並支付運輸發票；訪問全球貿易數據；歸檔進出口海關和安全文件；並透過參與世界上最大的協作多式聯運物流社區來完成眾多其他物流流程。該公司成立於1981年5月22日，總部位於加拿大滑鐵盧。

info.description: Gaxos.ai, Inc. is a technology-based company, which engages in the developing applications aimed at redefining the way they utilize artificial intelligence to optimize the user experience. The company was founded by Vadim Mats on October 27, 2021 and is headquartered in Roseland, NJ.
info.description_zh: Gaxos.ai, Inc. 是一家技術型公司，致力於開發應用程序，旨在重新定義利用人工智慧來優化用戶體驗的方式。該公司由 Vadim Mats 於 2021 年 10 月 27 日創立，總部位於新澤西州羅斯蘭。

info.description: Quest Resource Holding Corp. engages in the provision of waste and recycling services to customers from across multiple industry sectors that are typically larger, multi-location businesses. It focuses on the waste streams and recyclables from big box, food chain, and other retailers, automotive repair, maintenance, and tire operations, truck and bus fleet operators, manufacturing plants, multi-family and commercial properties, and construction and demolition projects. The company was founded in July 2002 and is headquartered in The Colony, TX.
info.description_zh: Quest Resource Holding Corp. 致力於為多個行業的客戶提供廢棄物和回收服務，這些行業通常是大型、多地點的企業。它專注於來自大賣場、食品連鎖店和其他零售商、汽車維修、保養和輪胎運營、卡車和公共汽車車隊運營商、製造工廠、多戶和商業地產以及建築和拆除項目的廢物流和可回收物。該公司成立於 2002 年 7 月，總部位於德克薩斯州科勒尼。

info.description: Great Elm Capital Corp., a publicly traded business development company located in the United States, which operates through the broad range of sectors. The company was founded on April 01, 2016, and is headquartered in Palm Beach Gardens, FL.
info.description_zh: Great Elm Capital Corp. 是一家位於美國的上市業務開發公司，業務涉及廣泛的行業。該公司成立於2016年4月1日，總部位於佛羅裡達州棕櫚灘花園。

info.description: Sera Prognostics, Inc. engages in the provision of personalized diagnostics to predict and manage pregnancy complications. It focuses on developing blood tests to predict the risks of preterm birth, preeclampsia and other pregnancy complications. The company was founded by Steven W. Graves, Dennis Farrar and M. Sean Esplin in 2008 and is headquartered in Salt Lake City, UT.
info.description_zh: Sera Prognostics, Inc. 致力於提供個人化診斷來預測和管理妊娠併發症。它的重點是開發血液檢查來預測早產、子癇前症和其他妊娠併發症的風險。該公司由 Steven W. Graves、Dennis Farrar 和 M. Sean Esplin 於 2008 年創立，總部位於猶他州鹽湖城。

info.description: Erasca, Inc. is a clinical stage precision oncology company. It focuses on discovering, developing, and commercializing therapies for patients with RAS/MAPK pathway-driven cancers. It has assembled a wholly owned or controlled RAS/MAPK pathway focused pipeline comprising modality-agnostic programs. The company was founded by Jonathan E. Lim and Kevan Shokat on July 2, 2018 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Erasca, Inc.是一家臨床階段精準腫瘤學公司。它專注於發現、開發和商業化針對 RAS/MAPK 路徑驅動的癌症患者的療法。它已經組成了一個全資擁有或控制的以 RAS/MAPK 通路為重點的管道，其中包括與模態無關的程序。該公司由 Jonathan E. Lim 和 Kevan Shokat 於 2018 年 7 月 2 日創立，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

info.description: SPS Commerce, Inc. engages in the provision of cloud-based supply chain management services. The firm serves retailers, suppliers, grocers, distributors and logistics firms to orchestrate the management of item data, order fulfillment, inventory control and sales analytics across all channels. Its SPS Commerce cloud services platform offers Trading Partner Community, Fulfillment, Assortment, Analytics, Sourcing, and Other Trading Partner Solutions. The company was founded by Gary W. Anderson and Roger Anderson on January 28, 1987 and is headquartered in Minneapolis, MN.
info.description_zh: SPS Commerce, Inc. 從事提供基於雲端的供應鏈管理服務。該公司為零售商、供應商、雜貨商、分銷商和物流公司提供服務，協調所有通路的商品資料管理、訂單履行、庫存控制和銷售分析。其 SPS Commerce 雲端服務平台提供貿易合作夥伴社群、履行、分類、分析、採購和其他貿易合作夥伴解決方案。該公司由 Gary W. Anderson 和 Roger Anderson 於 1987 年 1 月 28 日創立，總部位於明尼蘇達州明尼阿波利斯。

info.description: IM Cannabis Corp. engages in the production and sale of medical cannabis products. It offers dry flower products and cannabis oil products under the IMC brand. The company was founded on March 7, 1980 and is headquartered in Glil Yam, Israel.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: IM Cannabis Corp. 從事醫用大麻產品的生產和銷售。它以 IMC 品牌提供乾燥花產品和大麻油產品。該公司成立於1980年3月7日，總部位於以色列Glil Yam。

info.description: GeneDx Holdings Corp. operates as a health intelligence company. It engages in healthcare with the use of its collected disease data sets. It offers exome and genome testing for diagnosis of genetic disease. The company was founded by Eric Schadt in October 2015 and is headquartered in Stamford, CT.
info.description_zh: GeneDx Holdings Corp. 是一家健康情報公司。它利用收集的疾病數據集從事醫療保健。它提供用於診斷遺傳疾病的外顯子組和基因組測試。該公司由 Eric Sc​​hadt 於 2015 年 10 月創立，總部位於康乃狄克州斯坦福。

info.description: Namib Minerals is a gold producer, developer and explorer with operations focused in Zimbabwe. The company was founded on June 5, 2025 and is headquartered in George Town, Cayman Islands.
info.description_zh: Namib Minerals 是一家黃金生產商、開發商和勘探商，業務重點在於辛巴威。該公司成立於2025年6月5日，總部位於開曼群島喬治敦。

info.description: Arista Networks, Inc. engages in the development, marketing, and sale of cloud networking solutions. Its solutions include EOS, a set of network applications, and Gigabit Ethernet switching and routing platforms. Its product categories include Core, Cognitive Adjacencies, and Network Software and Services. The company was founded by Andreas Bechtolsheim, David Cheriton, and Kenneth Duda in November 2004 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA.
info.description_zh: Arista Networks, Inc. 從事雲端網路解決方案的開發、行銷和銷售。其解決方案包括EOS、一套網路應用程式以及千兆乙太網路交換和路由平台。其產品類別包括核心、認知鄰接以及網路軟體和服務。該公司由 Andreas Bechtolsheim、David Cheriton 和 Kenneth Duda 於 2004 年 11 月創立，總部位於加州聖克拉拉。

info.description: Liberty Live Holdings, Inc. is engaged in the entertainment industry. Its assets include Live Nation Entertainment, Quint, and Meyer Shank Racing. The company was founded in December 1992 and is headquartered in Englewood, CO.
info.description_zh: Liberty Live Holdings, Inc. 從事娛樂業。其資產包括 Live Nation Entertainment、Quint 和 Meyer Shank Racing。該公司成立於 1992 年 12 月，總部位於科羅拉多州恩格爾伍德。

info.description: China Natural Resources, Inc. is an investment holding company, which engages in the provision of exploration and mining in the People's Republic of China (PRC). It focuses on the exploration for lead, silver, and other metals, and copper trading in the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region of the PRC. The company was founded on December 14, 1993 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: 中國自然資源股份有限公司是一家投資控股公司，在中華人民共和國（中國）從事勘探和採礦業務。其專注於中國內蒙古自治區的鉛、銀及其他金屬勘探及銅貿易。公司成立於1993年12月14日，總部位於香港。

info.description: US Energy Corp. engages in the acquisition and development of oil and natural gas properties. It operates in Rockis, Mid Con, South Texas, and West Texas. The company was founded on January 26, 1966 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣勘探與生產
info.description_zh: 美國能源公司從事石油和天然氣資產的收購和開發。該公司在羅基斯、中部康州、德克薩斯州南部和西德克薩斯州開展業務。該公司成立於1966年1月26日，總部位於德克薩斯州休斯頓。

info.description: The Hackett Group, Inc. engages in the provision of dedicated expertise in generative artificial intelligence strategy, operations, finance, human capital management, strategic sourcing, procurement, and information technology. Its solutions include AI implementation, application managed services, applied intelligence programs, business benchmarking, cloud services, data and analytics, digital transformation, enterprise applications, Gen AI consulting, learning and development, outsourcing consulting, solution intelligence, strategic cost reduction, talent management, third-party risk management, and working capital management. It operates through the following segments: Global Strategy and Business Transformation (S&BT), Oracle Solutions, and SAP Solutions. The Global S&BT segment includes the results of the company's strategic business consulting practices. The Oracle Solutions segment is involved in oracle enterprise performance management, enterprise resource planning, and application maintenance and support practices. The SAP Solutions segment focuses on the SAP applications and related SAP service offerings. The company was founded by Ted A. Fernandez and David N. Dungan in 1991 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: Hackett Group, Inc. 致力於提供產生人工智慧策略、營運、財務、人力資本管理、策略採購、採購和資訊科技方面的專門專業知識。其解決方案包括人工智慧實施、應用託管服務、應用智慧專案、業務基準測試、雲端服務、數據和分析、數位轉型、企業應用、Gen AI諮詢、學習和開發、外包諮詢、解決方案智慧、策略成本降低、人才管理、第三方風險管理和營運資本管理。它透過以下部門運作：全球策略和業務轉型 (S&BT)、Oracle 解決方案和 SAP 解決方案。全球 S&BT 部門包括公司策略性商業諮詢實務的成果。 Oracle 解決方案部門涉及 Oracle 企業績效管理、企業資源規劃以及應用程式維護和支援實務。 SAP 解決方案部門專注於 SAP 應用程式和相關 SAP 服務產品。該公司由 Ted A. Fernandez 和 David N. Dungan 於 1991 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: Xenetic Biosciences, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company engaged in the advancement of cell-based therapeutics to target the B-cell receptor on the surface of an individual patient's malignant tumor cells. Its product pipeline includes XCart Platform and Polyxen. The company was founded on August 9, 2011 and is headquartered in Framingham, MA.
info.description_zh: Xenetic Biosciences, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於開發基於細胞的療法，以靶向個別患者惡性腫瘤細胞表面的 B 細胞受體。其產品線包括 XCart Platform 和 Polyxen。該公司成立於2011年8月9日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州弗雷明漢。

info.description: Freedom Holding Corp. operates as an investment company, which provides securities brokerage and financial services. The firm engages in a range of activities including securities brokerage, securities dealing for customers, market making activities, investment research, investment counseling, investment banking services, retail and commercial banking, insurance products, payment services, and information processing services. It operates through the following segments: Brokerage, Banking, Insurance, and Other. The company was founded in July 1981 is headquartered in Almaty, Kazakhstan.
info.description_zh: Freedom Holding Corp. 作為一家投資公司經營，提供證券經紀和金融服務。該公司從事一系列活動，包括證券經紀、客戶證券交易、做市活動、投資研究、投資諮詢、投資銀行服務、零售和商業銀行、保險產品、支付服務和資訊處理服務。它透過以下部門運作：經紀部門、銀行部門、保險部門和其他部門。該公司成立於1981年7月，總部位於哈薩克阿拉木圖。

info.description: Health Catalyst, Inc. engages in the provision of data and analytics technology and services to healthcare organizations. It operates through the Technology and Professional Services segments. The Technology segment includes its data platform, analytics applications, and support services. The Professional Services segment combines analytics, implementation, strategic advisory, outsource, and improvement services to deliver expertise to its customers. The company was founded by Steven C. Barlow and Thomas D. Burton in 2008 and is headquartered in South Jordan, UT.
info.description_zh: Health Catalyst, Inc. 致力於為醫療保健組織提供資料和分析技術及服務。它透過技術和專業服務部門運作。技術部門包括數據平台、分析應用程式和支援服務。專業服務部門結合了分析、實施、策略諮詢、外包和改進服務，為客戶提供專業知識。該公司由 Steven C. Barlow 和 Thomas D. Burton 於 2008 年創立，總部位於猶他州南喬丹。

info.description: Gartner, Inc. is a research and advisory company, which engages in the provision of insights, advice, and tools that help build organizations. It operates through the following segments: Insights, Consulting, Conferences, and Other. The Insights segment equips executives and their teams from every major function, geography, industry and sector with actionable, objective insights, guidance, and tools. The Consulting segment serves the chief information officer and other senior executives who are driving technology-driven strategic initiatives to optimize technology investments and drive business impact. The Conferences segment focuses on information technology and business executives as well as decision makers looking to adapt and evolve their organizations through disruption and uncertainty, navigate risks, and prioritize investments. The company was founded by Gideon I. Gartner and Dave L. R. Stein in 1979 and is headquartered in Stamford, CT.
info.description_zh: Gartner, Inc. 是一家研究和顧問公司，致力於提供有助於建立組織的見解、建議和工具。它透過以下部門運作：洞察部門、諮詢部門、會議部門和其他部門。洞察部門為來自各個主要職能、地理位置、產業和部門的高階主管及其團隊提供可行的、客觀的洞察、指導和工具。諮詢部門為資訊長和其他高階主管提供服務，他們推動技術驅動的策略計劃，以優化技術投資並推動業務影響。會議部分重點關注資訊科技和業務高管以及決策者，他們希望透過顛覆和不確定性來適應和發展其組織、駕馭風險並確定投資優先順序。該公司由 Gideon I. Gartner 和 Dave L. R. Stein 於 1979 年創立，總部位於康乃狄克州斯坦福。

info.description: MiNK Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery, development, and commercialization of allogeneic invariant natural killer T cell therapies to treat cancer and other immune mediated diseases. The company was founded by Garo H. Armen in 2017 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: MiNK Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段生物製藥公司，致力於同種異體不變自然殺手T細胞療法的發現、開發和商業化，以治療癌症和其他免疫介導的疾病。該公司由 Garo H. Armen 於 2017 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Five9, Inc. engages in the provision of cloud software for contact centers. It specializes in omnichannel routing, analytics, workforce organization, and reporting. The company was founded in December 2001 and is headquartered in San Ramon, CA.
info.description_zh: Five9, Inc. 致力於為聯絡中心提供雲端軟體。它專注於全通路路由、分析、勞動力組織和報告。該公司成立於 2001 年 12 月，總部位於加州聖拉蒙。

info.description: Foxx Development Holdings, Inc. engages in consumer electronics and integrated Internet-of-Things (IoT) solutions, catering to both retail and institutional clients. The company was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Irvine, CA.
info.description_zh: Foxx Development Holdings, Inc. 從事消費性電子產品和整合物聯網 (IoT) 解決方案，為零售和機構客戶提供服務。該公司成立於 2017 年，總部位於加州歐文。

info.description: MongoDB, Inc. engages in the development and provision of a general-purpose database platform. The firm's products include MongoDB Enterprise Advanced, MongoDB Atlas, and Community Server. It also offers professional services including consulting and training. The company was founded by Eliot Horowitz, Dwight A. Merriman, Kevin P. Ryan, and Geir Magnusson Jr. in November 2007 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: MongoDB, Inc. 從事通用資料庫平台的開發和提供。該公司的產品包括 MongoDB Enterprise Advanced、MongoDB Atlas 和 Community Server。它還提供包括諮詢和培訓在內的專業服務。該公司由 Eliot Horowitz、Dwight A. Merriman、Kevin P. Ryan 和 Geir Magnusson Jr. 於 2007 年 11 月創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Springview Holdings Ltd. engages in the design and construction of residential and commercial buildings. It involves new construction, reconstruction, alterations, and other general contracting services. The company was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Springview Holdings Ltd. 從事住宅和商業建築的設計和建造。涉及新建、改建、改建及其他總承包服務。該公司成立於2002年，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Sphere 3D Corp. is a bitcoin mining company. The firm is engaged in growing its digital asset mining operation through the capital-efficient procurement of next-generation mining equipment and partnering with data center operators. Its bitcoin mining business segment involves acquiring computer servers, which operate application-specific integrated circuit chips designed specifically to mine bitcoin, and deploy, such miners at-scale utilizing its hosting agreements. The company was founded on May 2, 2007 and is headquartered in Stamford, CT.
info.description_zh: Sphere 3D Corp. 是一家比特幣挖礦公司。該公司致力於透過資本高效的下一代採礦設備採購以及與資料中心營運商合作來發展其數位資產採礦業務。其比特幣挖礦業務部門涉及收購電腦伺服器，這些伺服器運行專門為挖掘比特幣而設計的專用集成電路晶片，並利用其託管協議大規模部署此類礦機。該公司成立於2007年5月2日，總部位於康乃狄克州斯坦福。

info.description: Blue Moon Metals Inc. engages in the acquisition and exploration of mineral resource properties. It focuses on Blue Moon zinc and Yava properties. The company was founded on January 15, 2007 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
info.description_zh: Blue Moon Metals Inc. 從事礦產資源的收購和勘探。它專注於 Blue Moon 鋅礦和 Yava 礦產。該公司成立於2007年1月15日，總部位於加拿大多倫多。

info.description: Cre8 Enterprise Ltd. engages in the provision of financial printing, typesetting, artwork design and translation services. The company through its subsidiary provides integrated financial printing services for listed companies, IPO applicants and private companies in the finance and capital market. The firm's services cover concept creation and artwork design, typesetting, proofreading, translation, printing, binding, logistics arrangement, uploading or making e-Submissions of financial reports and compliance documents on the website of the Stock Exchange and media placements. The company was founded on December 4, 2023 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Cre8 Enterprise Ltd. 從事提供財經印刷、排版、藝術品設計及翻譯服務。該公司透過其子公司為金融和資本市場的上市公司、IPO申請人和私人企業提供綜合財經印刷服務。該公司的服務涵蓋概念創作和美術設計、排版、校對、翻譯、印刷、裝訂、物流安排、在聯交所網站上傳或電子提交財務報告和合規文件以及媒體投放。該公司成立於2023年12月4日，總部位於香港。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long NET Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of NET. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of NET, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 NET 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 NET 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來提供 NET 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long ANET ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of Arista Networks, Inc. (NYSE: ANET). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the Underlying Security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. The fund manager is expected to allocate between 40% and 60% of fund's assets as collateral for swap agreements or as premiums for purchased options contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance 每日目標 2 倍多頭 ANET ETF 尋求 Arista Networks, Inc.（NYSE：ANET）每日股價變動百分比兩倍 (200%) 的每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），試圖透過使用衍生性商品（即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約）來實現基礎證券股價每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。基金經理人預計將分配 40% 至 60% 的基金資產作為掉期協議的抵押品或作為購買選擇權合約的溢價。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Enlivex Ltd. engages in the development of macrophage reprogramming immunotherapy products. It focuses on the development of Allocetra, a universal off-the-shelf cell therapy designed to reprogram macrophages into their homeostatic state. The company was founded by Dror Mevorach on January 22, 2012 and is headquartered in Ness Ziona, Israel.
info.description_zh: Enlivex Ltd.從事巨噬細胞重編程免疫治療產品的開發。它專注於 Allocetra 的開發，這是一種通用的現成細胞療法，旨在將巨噬細胞重新編程至穩態。該公司由 Dror Mevorach 於 2012 年 1 月 22 日創立，總部位於以色列 Ness Ziona。

info.description: Brand Engagement Network, Inc. engages in the provision of conversational artificial intelligence assistants with the purpose of transforming engagement and analytics for businesses through security-focused, multimodal communication and human-like artificial intelligence assistants. The firm is also involved in delivering highly personalized, multi-modal artificial intelligence engagement with a focus on industries where there is a massive workforce gap and an opportunity to transform how consumers engage with networks, providers, and brands. The company is founded by Tyler J. Luck, Michael Lucas, Patrick Nunally & Hanseok Ko on March 14, 2024 and is headquartered in Wilmington, DE.
info.description_zh: Brand Engagement Network, Inc. 致力於提供對話式人工智慧助手，旨在透過以安全為中心的多模式通訊和類人人工智慧助理來改變企業的參與和分析。該公司也致力於提供高度個人化、多模式的人工智慧參與，重點關注勞動力缺口巨大的產業，並有機會改變消費者與網路、供應商和品牌的互動方式。該公司由 Tyler J. Luck、Michael Lucas、Patrick Nunally 和 Hanseok Ko 於 2024 年 3 月 14 日創立，總部位於特拉華州威爾明頓。

info.description: Opendoor Technologies, Inc. engages in the operation of buying, selling, and trading of residential properties online. The company was founded by Eric Wu on December 30, 2013, and is headquartered in Tempe, AZ.
info.description_zh: Opendoor Technologies, Inc. 從事住宅物業的線上購買、銷售和交易業務。該公司由 Eric Wu 於 2013 年 12 月 30 日創立，總部位於亞利桑那州坦佩。

info.description: Aureus Greenway Holdings, Inc. engages in the ownership and operation of public golf country clubs, namely Kissimmee Bay Country Club and Remington Golf Club. It operates through the following segments: Golf Recreation, Retail Golf Products, and Equipment and Facilities Rental, Membership Dues, Food and Beverage Services, and Ancillary Services and Amenities. The Golf Recreation, Retail Golf Products, and Equipment and Facilities Rental segment is involved in the collection of fees for every round of eighteen holes, provision of driving ranges for practice, sale of golf apparel and equipment, and rental of golf products and cars. The Membership Dues segment refers to the membership fees for customers to access the club's facilities and services for a set period or daily at the point of sale. The Food and Beverage Services segment provides culinary services such as catering. The Ancillary Services and Amenities segment offers leisure activities hosted in an on-premises clubhouse, kitchen, bar, and dining area. The company was founded on December 22, 2023 and is headquartered in Kissimmee, FL.
info.description_zh: Aureus Greenway Holdings, Inc. 從事公共高爾夫鄉村俱樂部的所有權和運營，即基西米灣鄉村俱樂部和雷明頓高爾夫俱樂部。它透過以下部門運作：高爾夫娛樂部門、零售高爾夫產品部門、設備和設施租賃部門、會員費部門、餐飲服務部門以及輔助服務和便利設施部門。高爾夫娛樂、零售高爾夫產品以及設備和設施租賃分部涉及每輪十八洞收費、提供練習場、銷售高爾夫服裝和設備以及租賃高爾夫產品和汽車。會員費部分是指顧客在一定期限內或每天在銷售點使用俱樂部設施和服務所繳納的會員費。餐飲服務部門提供餐飲等烹飪服務。輔助服務和設施部分提供在內部俱樂部會所、廚房、酒吧和用餐區舉辦的休閒活動。該公司成立於2023年12月22日，總部位於佛羅裡達州基西米。

info.description: Atai Beckley, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing effective, rapid-acting, and convenient mental health treatments. The company is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Atai Beckley, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，專注於開發有效、快速、方便的心理健康治療方法。該公司總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2x Long FCX Daily ETF is an exchange-traded fund that seeks to provide daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the common stock of Freeport-McMoRan Inc. The fund employs a leveraged strategy to amplify the daily performance of its underlying security through the use of financial derivative instruments and direct investment.
info.description_zh: Leverage Shares 2x Long FCX Daily ETF 是一款交易所交易基金，旨在提供 Freeport-McMoRan Inc. 普通股每日百分比變化兩倍 (200%) 的每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金採用槓桿策略，透過使用金融衍生工具和直接投資來放大其基礎證券的每日表現。

info.description: NextPlat Corp. engages in the provision of satellite-based services and solutions for commercial, government and individual users. The firm's services include satellite communication solutions, emergency location systems, high-speed satellite internet and global asset and personnel monitoring, customized ground station systems and custom product design. It operates through the e-Commerce Operations and Healthcare Operations segments. The e-Commerce Operations segment refers to acquiring and leasing, primarily an e-commerce platform to collaborate with businesses to optimize their ability to sell their goods online, domestically, and internationally. The Healthcare Operations segment refers TPA, data management, COVID-19 related diagnostics and vaccinations, prescription pharmaceuticals, compounded medications, tele pharmacy services, anti-retroviral medications, and medication therapy management. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Hallandale Beach, FL.
info.description_zh: NextPlat Corp. 致力於為商業、政府和個人用戶提供基於衛星的服務和解決方案。該公司的服務包括衛星通訊解決方案、緊急定位系統、高速衛星互聯網和全球資產和人員監控、客製化地面站系統和客製化產品設計。它透過電子商務營運和醫療保健營運部門運作。電子商務營運部門涉及收購和租賃，主要是一個與企業合作的電子商務平台，以優化其在國內和國際上在線銷售商品的能力。醫療保健營運部門涉及 TPA、資料管理、COVID-19 相關診斷和疫苗接種、處方藥、複方藥物、遠距藥房服務、抗逆轉錄病毒藥物和藥物治療管理。該公司成立於 1997 年，總部位於佛羅裡達州哈倫代爾海灘。

info.description: Galaxy Payroll Group Ltd. is a holding company which provides payroll outsourcing services. It also offers employment, consultancy and market research services. The outsourcing services assist its end-users in calculating employees' salaries and the required employer's contributions to social security and housing provident funds as well as individual income tax and any other deductions. The employment services act as the employers of record to employ suitable candidates, who are sourced by their end-users. The consultancy and market research services provides consultation for local policy and delivery of country profile reports. The company was founded by Wai Hong Lao, Yiu Kong But, and Wai Cheung Yeung in April 2013 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Galaxy Payroll Group Ltd.是一家提供薪資外包服務的控股公司。它還提供就業、諮詢和市場研究服務。外包服務協助最終用戶計算員工薪資、雇主所需繳納的社會安全和住房公積金以及個人所得稅和任何其他扣除項目。就業服務機構作為記錄雇主來僱用合適的候選人，這些候選人是由其最終用戶尋找的。諮詢和市場研究服務為當地政策提供諮詢並提供國家概況報告。該公司由Wai Hong Lao、Yiu Kong But和Wai Cheung Yeung於2013年4月創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: Epsium Enterprise Ltd. operates as a holding company, which engages in import trading and distribution of wines and spirits. It offers a range of products, including Chinese liquor, French cognac, Scottish whisky, fine wines, champagne, and other miscellaneous alcoholic beverages. Its brands include Moutai, Xijiu, Wuliangye, Remy Martin Cognac, Macallan, Cointreau, Piper Heidsieck Champagne, French Fine Wines, Red and White Wines. The company was founded by Son I Tam on March 24, 2020 and is headquartered in Macau.
info.industry_zh: 飲料 - 釀酒廠和釀酒廠
info.description_zh: Epsium Enterprise Ltd. 作為一家控股公司運營，從事葡萄酒和烈酒的進口貿易和分銷。它提供一系列產品，包括中國白酒、法國干邑白蘭地、蘇格蘭威士忌、精品葡萄酒、香檳和其他各種酒精飲料。旗下品牌包括茅台、習酒、五糧液、人頭馬干邑、麥卡倫、君度、海德雪香檳、法國精品葡萄酒、紅白葡萄酒等。該公司由Son I Tam於2020年3月24日創立，總部位於澳門。

info.description: Celularity, Inc. is a clinical stage biotechnology company, which engages in the development of off-the-shelf placental-derived allogeneic cell therapies for the treatment of cancer and immune and infectious diseases. It operates through the following segments: Cell Therapy, BioBanking, Degenerative Disease, and Other. The Cell Therapy segment consists of the therapies the company is researching and developing. The BioBanking segment focuses on stem cells from umbilical cords and placentas and provides storage of such cells on behalf of individuals for future use. The Degenerative Disease segment offers products used in surgical and wound care markets. The company was founded by Robert Joseph Hariri Gordon in 2016 and is headquartered in Florham Park, NJ.
info.description_zh: Celularity, Inc.是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，致力於開發現成的胎盤來源同種異體細胞療法，用於治療癌症、免疫和傳染病。它透過以下部門運作：細胞治療、生物銀行、退化性疾病等。細胞療法部門由公司正在研究和開發的療法組成。生物銀行部門專注於來自臍帶和胎盤的幹細胞，並代表個人儲存此類細胞以供將來使用。退化性疾病部門提供外科和傷口護理市場的產品。該公司由 Robert Joseph Hariri Gordon 於 2016 年創立，總部位於新澤西州弗洛勒姆公園。

info.description: Semilux International Ltd. engages in the development of laser lights modules and optical components. The company was founded on July 19, 2023 and is headquartered in George Town, Cayman Islands.
info.description_zh: Semilux International Ltd.從事雷射燈模組和光學元件的開發。該公司成立於2023年7月19日，總部位於開曼群島喬治敦。

info.description: Bio Green Med Solution, Inc. which engages in the supply and trading of protective and fire safety equipment to commercial, industrial, healthcare, and residential sectors. Its products include fire extinguishers, foam system, fire-resistant doors, and personal protective equipment. The company was founded by Ronald J. Berenson, David Philip Lane, and David Glover on January 5, 1996 and is headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
info.description_zh: Bio Green Med Solution, Inc. 從事商業、工業、醫療保健和住宅領域的防護和消防安全設備的供應和貿易。其產品包括滅火器、泡沫系統、防火門和個人防護設備。該公司由 Ronald J. Berenson、David Philip Lane 和 David Glover 於 1996 年 1 月 5 日創立，總部位於馬來西亞吉隆坡。

info.description: VisionSys AI, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of IT-focused supplementary science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM) education services. It operates an education platform that has live distance instruction, classroom-based learning, and online learning modules. The company was founded by Shao Yun Han in September 2002 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: VisionSys AI, Inc. 是一家控股公司，致力於提供以 IT 為重點的補充科學、技術、工程和數學 (STEM) 教育服務。它經營一個教育平台，具有遠距教學、課堂學習和線上學習模組。該公司由邵雲韓於2002年9月創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Guardforce AI Co., Ltd. engages in the provision of integrated security solutions. It operates through the following segments: Secured Logistics, AI and Robotics Solutions, General Security Solutions, and Corporate and Others. The Corporate and Others segment covers the non-operating activities supporting the company. The company was founded on April 20, 2018 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: 衛安人工智慧有限公司從事提供綜合安全解決方案。該公司透過以下部門運作：安全物流部門、人工智慧和機器人解決方案部門、通用安全解決方案部門以及企業及其他部門。本公司及其他部門涵蓋支援公司的非經營活動。該公司成立於2018年4月20日，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Veru, Inc. is a late clinical stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing novel medicines and treatment of cardiometabolic and inflammatory diseases. Its drug development program consists of two late-stage new chemical entities, enobosarm and sabizabulin. The company was founded by William R. Gargiulo, Jr. and O. B. Parrish in 1971 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: Veru, Inc. 是一家處於後期臨床階段的生物製藥公司，專注於開發新藥以及治療心臟代謝和發炎疾病。其藥物開發計劃包括兩種後期新化學實體：enobosarm 和 sabizabulin。該公司由 William R. Gargiulo, Jr. 和 O. B. Parrish 於 1971 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: Jin Medical International Ltd. is a holding company. It is engaged in the design, development, manufacturing, and sale of wheelchair and other living aids products to be used by people with disabilities or impaired mobility. The company was founded on January 14, 2020 and is headquartered in Changzhou, China.
info.description_zh: 金醫療國際股份有限公司是一家控股公司。其從事設計、開發、製造和銷售供殘疾人或行動不便人士使用的輪椅及其他生活輔助產品。公司成立於2020年1月14日，總部位於中國常州。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2x Long DNN Daily ETF is an aggressively managed single-stock exchange-traded fund that targets daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily price performance of the common stock of Denison Mines Corp. The fund is designed as a tactical tool for sophisticated investors to amplify short-term bullish views on a prominent uranium exploration and development company through the use of daily-resetting financial derivatives.
info.description_zh: Leverage Shares 2x Long DNN Daily ETF 是一款積極管理的單一股票交易所交易基金，其目標是丹尼森礦業公司 (Denison Mines Corp) 普通股每日價格表現的 200% 的每日投資業績（扣除費用和開支）。該基金旨在作為成熟投資者的戰術工具，透過使用每日重置的金融衍生性商品來放大對一家著名鈾勘探和開發公司的短期看漲觀點。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long OPEN Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of OPEN. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of OPEN, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 OPEN 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 OPEN 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些工具結合起來提供 200% 每日槓桿敞口，與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Decent Holding, Inc. engages in the provision of wastewater treatment by cleansing the industrial wastewater, ecological river restoration, and river ecosystem management. Its products and services include river water quality management and microbial products for water quality enhancement and pollutant cleansing purposes. The company was founded by Ding Xin Sun on January 6, 2022 and is headquartered in Yantai, China.
info.description_zh: Decent Holding, Inc. 從事工業廢水淨化、河川生態修復和河川生態系統管理等廢水處理業務。其產品和服務包括河流水質管理以及用於水質提高和污染物淨化的微生物產品。該公司由孫鼎新於2022年1月6日創立，總部位於中國煙台。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long MP Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of MP. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of MP, consistent with the fund's investment objective. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 MP 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 MP 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來提供 MP 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Abits Group, Inc. engages in the provision of Internet media marketing services in China and bitcoin mining and related services in the United States. It is the operator of the Games Channel of the Xinhua App, an application developed and operated by Xinhua New China News Agency. The company was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: Abits Group, Inc.在中國提供網路媒體行銷服務，在美國提供比特幣挖礦及相關服務。它是新華社開發和運營的應用程式“新華社”遊戲頻道的運營商。公司成立於2013年，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Wellchange Holdings Co. Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of enterprise software solution services. It provides tailor-made software solutions, cloud-based software-as-a-service (SaaS) services, and white-labelled software design and development services. The company was founded by Kin Pong Shek on July 13, 2023, and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Wellchange Holdings Co. Ltd.是一家控股公司，從事提供企業軟體解決方案服務。它提供量身定制的軟體解決方案、基於雲端的軟體即服務（SaaS）服務以及白標軟體設計和開發服務。該公司由Kin Pong Shek於2023年7月13日創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: Scage Future is a new energy smart solutions provider for heavy commercial vehicles. It develops and commercializes heavy-duty new energy trucks and components, and also provides related vehicle modification and leasing services. The company was founded by Chao Gao, Yuan Chi Guo, and Zi Qian Guan in June 2019 and is headquartered in Nanjing, China.
info.description_zh: Scage Future是重型商用車新能源智慧解決方案供應商。它開發和商業化重型新能源卡車及零件，並提供相關的車輛改裝和租賃服務。該公司由高超、郭元馳和關子謙於2019年6月創立，總部位於中國南京。

info.description: Real Messenger Corp. is a communication company, which engages in real estate communication. The company connects shareholders through its app that enables real time messaging, documentation, and integration with other real estate software. The company was founded by Kwai Hoi Ma on June 27, 2023 and is headquartered in Costa Mesa, CA.
info.description_zh: Real Messenger Corp. 是一家從事房地產通訊的通訊公司。該公司透過其應用程式將股東聯繫起來，該應用程式支援即時訊息傳遞、文件記錄以及與其他房地產軟體的整合。該公司由 Kwai Hoi Ma 於 2023 年 6 月 27 日創立，總部位於加州科斯塔梅薩。

info.description: Jianzhi Education Technology Group Co., Ltd. engages in the provision of educational content and information technology (IT) solutions. It operates through the IT Related Solution Services and Educational Content Services and Other Services. The IT Related Solutions Services segment offers IT related solution services such as software solutions and customizes intelligent solutions, and related services including maintenance and technical support services. The Educational Content segment covers the provision and licensing of educational content. The company was founded by Pei Xuan Wang in May 2011 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: 建智教育科技集團股份有限公司從事提供教育內容與資訊科技（IT）解決方案。它透過 IT 相關解決方案服務、教育內容服務和其他服務運作。 IT相關解決方案服務部門提供軟體解決方案和客製化智慧解決方案等IT相關解決方案服務，以及維護和技術支援服務等相關服務。教育內容部門涵蓋教育內容的提供與許可。該公司由王培軒於2011年5月創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Hitek Global, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of information technology consulting and solutions. It operates through the services to small and medium businesses, which consists of anti-counterfeiting tax control system tax devices, golden tax disk and printers, and information technology services; and services to hardware and software sales business lines. The company was founded by Shen Ping Yin on November 3, 2017 and is headquartered in Xiamen, China.
info.description_zh: Hitek Global, Inc. 是一家控股公司，從事提供資訊科技諮詢和解決方案。其營運範圍為中小企業服務，包括防偽稅控系統稅控設備、金稅盤和印表機以及資訊科技服務；以及硬體和軟體銷售業務線的服務。該公司由沈平尹於2017年11月3日創立，總部位於中國廈門。

info.description: Alvotech is a biotechnology company, which engages in the development and manufacture of biosimilar medicines. The firm is focusing on the development of its product candidates. It operates through the following geographical segments: Europe, North America, Asia, and Other. The company was founded by Robert Vilhelm Wessman in 2013 and is headquartered in Luxembourg.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Alvotech是一家生技公司，從事生物相似藥的開發和製造。該公司正專注於候選產品的開發。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：歐洲、北美、亞洲和其他地區。該公司由 Robert Vilhelm Wessman 於 2013 年創立，總部位於盧森堡。

info.description: Indaptus Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical biotechnology company. The firm engages in the development of a novel and patented systemically-administered anti-cancer and anti-viral immunotherapy. It created patented treatment methods and associated patented compositions for attenuation and killing of non-pathogenic, Gram-negative bacteria. The company was founded by Michael James Newman on February 24, 2021 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Indaptus Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床生物技術公司。該公司致力於開發一種新型的、專利的系統性抗癌和抗病毒免疫療法。它創造了專利治療方法和相關專利組合物，用於減弱和殺死非致病性革蘭氏陰性細菌。該公司由邁克爾詹姆斯紐曼於 2021 年 2 月 24 日創立，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Fortrea Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of clinical development and commercialization services. It operates under the Clinical Services and Enabling Services Segments. The Clinical Services segment provides services across the clinical pharmacology, clinical development, and other clinical service spectrum utilizing enabling services and technology through multiple delivery models. The Enabling Services segment provides technology solutions directly to customers that streamline complex randomization and optimize the trial drug supply process, while minimizing operational costs and supporting timely and accurate patient dosing. The company was founded on January 31, 2023 and is headquartered in Durham, NC.
info.description_zh: Fortrea Holdings, Inc. 從事提供臨床開發和商業化服務。它在臨床服務和支援服務部門下運作。臨床服務部門透過多種交付模式利用支援服務和技術提供跨臨床藥理學、臨床開發和其他臨床服務範圍的服務。賦能服務部門直接向客戶提供技術解決方案，簡化複雜的隨機化並優化試驗藥物供應流程，同時最大限度地降低營運成本並支援及時、準確的患者給藥。該公司成立於2023年1月31日，總部位於北卡羅來納州達勒姆。

info.description: PDF Solutions, Inc. engages in the provision of an end-to-end analytics platform that empowers engineers and data scientists across the semiconductor ecosystem and data analytics for process-design optimization and yield enhancement. Its products, services, and platforms include proprietary software, physical intellectual property (IP) for integrated circuit (IC) designs, electrical measurement hardware tools, proven methodologies, and professional services. The company was founded by John Kachig Kibarian and Kimon W. Michaels in 1991 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA.
info.description_zh: PDF Solutions, Inc. 致力於提供端到端分析平台，為整個半導體生態系統的工程師和資料科學家提供支持，並透過資料分析實現製程設計最佳化和產量提高。其產品、服務和平台包括專有軟體、積體電路（IC）設計的實體智慧財產權（IP）、電氣測量硬體工具、經過驗證的方法和專業服務。該公司由 John Kachig Kibarian 和 Kimon W. Michaels 於 1991 年創立，總部位於加州聖克拉拉。

info.description: Direxion Daily MSFT Bear 1X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 100% of the inverse (or opposite) of the daily performance of Microsoft Corporation. The fund will enter into one or more swap agreements with major global financial institutions whereby the fund and the global financial institution will agree to exchange the return earned on an investment by the fund in MSFT that is equal, on a daily basis, to -100% of the value of the fund's net assets. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily MSFT Bear 1X Shares 尋求與 Microsoft Corporation 每日表現相反（或相反）100% 的每日投資表現（扣除費用和開支）。該基金將與全球主要金融機構簽訂一項或多項互換協議，根據該協議，該基金和全球金融機構將同意交換該基金在 MSFT 的投資所賺取的每日回報，該回報等於該基金淨資產價值的-100%。它是非多元化的。

info.description: VanEck Healthcare TruSector ETF is an actively managed exchange-traded fund designed to provide uncapped, pure-play exposure to the U.S. healthcare sector by overcoming traditional diversification limits that often cap the weight of the largest industry leaders. The fund employs a "TruSector" hybrid structural approach, combining direct equity investments with targeted sector ETFs to ensure the portfolio's weights accurately reflect the true market-capitalization hierarchy of the healthcare industry, including its most dominant mega-cap constituents.
info.description_zh: VanEck Healthcare TruSector ETF 是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，旨在透過克服傳統的多元化限制（通常會限制最大產業領導者的權重），為美國醫療保健產業提供無上限的純投資曝險。該基金採用「TruSector」混合結構方法，將直接股權投資與目標產業 ETF 結合，以確保投資組合的權重準確反映醫療保健產業的真實市值等級，包括其最具主導地位的大股成分股。

info.description: WEBs Defined Volatility XLV ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond to the performance of the Syntax Defined Volatility XLV Index. The fund implements its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets (including borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments that achieve the investment results of the index. The index is a rules-based strategy that seeks to track the net asset value of a portfolio of securities of companies in the health care sector of the large-cap U.S. equity market. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WEBs Defined Volatility XLV ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支先前與 Syntax Defined Volatility XLV 指數表現相對應的投資結果。該基金透過在正常市場條件下將至少80%的淨資產（包括用於投資目的的借款）投資於實現指數投資結果的金融工具來實現其投資目標。該指數是一種基於規則的策略，旨在追蹤美國大盤股市場醫療保健行業公司證券投資組合的資產淨值。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: K2 Capital Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. Its business objective is purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization with one or more businesses. The company was founded on August 01, 2025 and is headquartered in George Town, Cayman Islands.

info.description: Leapfrog Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It engages in the effecting of a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, recapitalization, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on June 20, 2025 and is headquartered in Summit, NJ.
info.description_zh: Leapfrog Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它從事與一個或多個企業的合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、資本重組、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年6月20日，總部位於新澤西州薩米特。

info.description: IB Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. info.description_zh: IB Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2020年7月7日，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: FIGX Capital Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, and reorganization or similar business combination. The company was founded on February 20, 2025 and is headquartered in Tiburon, CA.
info.description_zh: FigX Capital Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立是為了實現合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於 2025 年 2 月 20 日，總部位於加州蒂伯龍。

info.description: JE Cleantech Holdings Ltd. engages in the sale of cleaning systems and other equipment and the provision of centralized dishwashing and ancillary services. The firm designs, develops, manufactures and sells cleaning systems for various industrial end-use applications to customers mainly in Singapore and Malaysia. It is also a centralized dishwashing services provider in Singapore. The company was founded by Hong Bee Yin in November 1999 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: JE Cleantech Holdings Ltd.從事清潔系統和其他設備的銷售以及提供集中洗碗和輔助服務。該公司為各種工業最終用途應用設計、開發、製造和銷售清潔系統，客戶主要位於新加坡和馬來西亞。它也是新加坡一家集中式洗碗服務供應商。該公司由 Hong Bee Yin 於 1999 年 11 月創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Magic Empire Global Ltd. engages in the provision of corporate finance advisory and underwriting services. It offers sponsorship, financial advisory, compliance advisory, and underwriting and corporate services. The company was founded by Wai Ho Chan and Sze Hon Chen on May 10, 2016 and is headquartered Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Magic Empire Global Ltd. 從事提供企業融資諮詢及承銷服務。它提供贊助、財務諮詢、合規諮詢以及承銷和企業服務。該公司由Wai Ho Chan和Sze Hon Chen於2016年5月10日創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: Pathfinder Bancorp, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the investment in Pathfinder Bank. It offers checking and savings accounts, loans, and digital banking services for retail and business customers through its subsidiary. The firm also provides overdraft protection and mobile payments for individual clients and cash management sweep accounts, remote deposit capture, and merchant card services for business clients. The company was founded on December 31, 1997 and is headquartered in Oswego, NY.
info.description_zh: Pathfinder Bancorp, Inc. 是一家控股公司，從事對 Pathfinder Bank 的投資。該公司透過其子公司為零售和企業客戶提供支票和儲蓄帳戶、貸款和數位銀行服務。該公司還為個人客戶提供透支保護和行動支付，並為企業客戶提供現金管理掃款帳戶、遠端存款取得和商業卡服務。該公司成立於1997年12月31日，總部位於紐約州奧斯威戈。

info.description: Quetta Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, which engages in effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, and reorganization or similar business combination. The company was founded on May 1, 2023 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Quetta Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，從事合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2023年5月1日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Strive, Inc. engages in the provision of an asset management Bitcoin treasury. It is focused on maximizing value for shareholders, accumulating bitcoin and outperforming bitcoin over the long run. The company was founded by Arshia Sarkhani, Jackson Fairbanks, Arman Sarkhani, and Kyle Fairbanks on March 9, 2022 and is headquartered in Dallas, TX.
info.description_zh: Strive, Inc. 從事提供資產管理比特幣金庫業務。它專注於為股東實現價值最大化、累積比特幣並從長遠來看超越比特幣。該公司由 Arshia Sarkhani、Jackson Fairbanks、Arman Sarkhani 和 Kyle Fairbanks 於 2022 年 3 月 9 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州達拉斯。

info.description: CO2 Energy Transition Corp. is a blank check company, which engages in effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, and similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. It focuses on the carbon capture, utilization, and storage industries. The company was founded on September 30, 2021 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: CO2 Energy Transition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，從事與一個或多個企業或實體進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組和類似業務合併。它專注於碳捕獲、利用和儲存產業。該公司成立於2021年9月30日，總部位於德州休士頓。

info.description: VanEck Financials TruSector ETF is an actively managed exchange-traded fund designed to provide comprehensive, uncapped exposure to the financials sector by utilizing a hybrid investment approach. The fund addresses the limitations of traditional market-cap-weighted sector indexes-which often underweight the largest constituents to maintain regulatory compliance-by combining direct equity investments with targeted sector ETFs to more accurately reflect the sector's true market-capitalization composition.
info.description_zh: VanEck Financials TruSector ETF 是一款主動管理的交易所交易基金，旨在透過利用混合投資方式提供全面、無上限的金融業投資。該基金透過將直接股權投資與目標產業 ETF 結合，解決了傳統市值加權產業指數的局限性（該指數通常會低估最大的成分股以維持監管合規性），以更準確地反映該行業的真實市值組成。

info.description: T. Rowe Price Financials ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in securities of financial companies. The manager defines financial companies as companies in banking, insurance, consumer finance, capital markets, government-sponsored financial enterprises, securities exchanges, REITS, transaction and payment processing, mortgage finance, investment management, and/or financial services. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: T. Rowe Price Financials ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金通常將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於金融公司的證券。管理者將金融公司定義為銀行、保險、消費金融、資本市場、政府資助的金融企業、證券交易所、房地產投資信託基金、交易和支付處理、抵押貸款融資、投資管理和/或金融服務領域的公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: WEBs Defined Volatility XLF ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond to the performance of the Syntax Defined Volatility XLF Index. The index is a rules-based strategy that seeks to track the net asset value of a portfolio of securities of companies in the financial sector of the large-cap U.S. equity market. The fund implements its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets (including borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments that achieve the investment results of the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WEBs Defined Volatility XLF ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支先前與 Syntax Defined Volatility XLF 指數表現相對應的投資結果。該指數是一種基於規則的策略，旨在追蹤美國大型股票市場金融領域公司的證券投資組合的資產淨值。該基金透過在正常市場條件下將至少80%的淨資產（包括用於投資目的的借款）投資於實現指數投資結果的金融工具來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Deere & Co. engages in the manufacture and distribution of equipment used in agriculture, construction, forestry, and turf care. It operates through the following segments: Agriculture and Turf, Construction and Forestry, and Financial Services. The Agriculture and Turf segment focuses on the distribution and manufacture of a full line of agriculture and turf equipment and related service parts. The Construction and Forestry segment offers machines and service parts used in construction, earthmoving, road building, material handling and timber harvesting. The Financial Services segment finances sales and leases by John Deere dealers of new and used agriculture and turf equipment and construction and forestry equipment. The company was founded by John Deere in 1837 and is headquartered in Moline, IL.
